article_content: Patricia Glancy, a 36-year-old wedding planner from Ascot, Berkshire, defrauded five couples preparing to marry at the prestigious Wentworth Golf Club in Surrey. Between March and June 2013, she convinced them to leave blank checks for wedding deposits — checks she later filled out with her own name and deposited into her personal account, stealing a total of £10,787.50. Glancy admitted to the fraud but avoided immediate imprisonment after it was revealed she used much of the stolen money to fund a final trip to New York for her terminally ill friend, Thelma Harte, and to donate generously to two cancer hospices. She also purchased equipment from the club’s pro shop at a discount and auctioned the items to raise additional funds for charity. The scam came to light when a bride attempted to contact Glancy via email — only to learn she had already resigned. Wentworth Golf Club, demonstrating remarkable integrity, covered all lost deposits to ensure the weddings proceeded as planned. At Guildford Crown Court, Judge Peter Moss acknowledged Glancy’s remorse, her full repayment of the stolen sum, and her good character. While stating the offense warranted custody, he suspended her six-month prison sentence for 18 months, warning that any further crime during that period would trigger immediate incarceration. Glancy was also ordered to pay £350 in court costs.
translated_content: Patricija Glancy, 36 gadus veca kāzu plānotāja no Ascot, Berkšīras, apkrāpa piecus pārus, kas gatavojās apprecēties prestižajā Wentworth Golf Club Savrijā. No martā līdz jūnijam 2013. gada viņa pārliecināja viņus atstāt tukšus čekus kāzu depozītam — čekus, kurus vēlāk aizpildīja ar savu vārdu un ievietoja savā personiskajā kontā, nozagdama kopā 10 787,50 lietas britu mārciņas. Glancy atzina krāpniecību, bet izvairījās no nekavējoties ieslodzījuma, jo tika atklāts, ka lielu daļu no zagtajām naudas summām viņa izmantoja, lai finansētu savas nāves gaitā esošā drauga Telfmas Hartes pēdējo ceļojumu uz Ņujorku un veiktu lielus ziedojumus divām vēža hospicu organizācijām. Viņa arī nopirka aprīkojumu no kluba profesionālā veikala ar atlaidi un izdeva šos priekšmetus uzlabošanai, lai savāktu papildu naudu labdarībai. Krāpniecība tika atklāta, kad viena līgavai mēģināja sūtīt Glancy e-pastu — un uzzināja, ka viņa jau ir atstājusi klubu. Wentworth Golf Club, demonstrējot izcilu integritāti, sega visus zaudētos depozītus, lai nodrošinātu, ka kāzas noritēja plānotajā veidā. Guildfordas Krona tiesā tiesnesis Pīters Moss atzina Glancy žēlību, pilnu naudas atdevi un viņas labu raksturu. Lai gan tiesnesis norādīja, ka noziegums prasa ieslodzījumu, viņš suspendēja viņas sešu mēnešu ieslodzījumu uz 18 mēnešiem, brīdinot, ka jebkurš nākamais noziegums šajā laikā izraisīs nekavējoties ieslodzījumu. Glancy tika arī piespriests samaksāt 350 lietas britu mārciņas tiesas izmaksas.

article_content: In Pyongyang, North Korea, a historic military parade unfolded Sunday morning, marking the anniversary of the Workers' Party of Korea. At the center of the spectacle was a rare public appearance by leader Kim Jong Il alongside his youngest son, Kim Jong Un — widely seen as his designated successor. Thousands of soldiers marched in perfect unison, accompanied by rows of tanks and long-range missiles, as crowds erupted in applause upon the Kims’ arrival at Kim Il Sung Square. The event, featuring 20,000 personnel from the Korean People's Army and auxiliary forces, was a grand display of military might. Kim Jong Un, believed to be in his late 20s and educated abroad, stunned observers by appearing in civilian clothing rather than his newly awarded four-star general’s uniform. Experts suggest this was a deliberate gesture to avoid provoking senior military figures still loyal to his father. North Korea unusually opened its doors to around 60 international journalists, though security remained intense — even notebooks and pens were inspected. CNN’s Alina Cho noted the surreal contrast: electricity flowed freely across the city, a rarity in a nation plagued by chronic power shortages. The parade followed a lavish Arirang festival at May Day Stadium, where hundreds of performers rehearsed for hours daily in a choreographed tribute to the regime. Kim Jong Il and his son watched from a private box, separated from the masses. While state media hailed the event as proof of the party’s enduring strength and prosperity under Kim Jong Il’s leadership, outside analysts questioned the timing. With widespread poverty and economic decline, many ordinary North Koreans may struggle to reconcile the extravagance with their daily hardships. Chinese President Hu Jintao sent a congratulatory message, praising North Korea’s 'socialist achievements' and reaffirming Beijing’s commitment to strengthening bilateral relations. The Workers’ Party itself declared the occasion the 'greatest heyday' in its history — a narrative echoed by state propaganda.

Kim Džunguns, kuram ir apmēram 27–28 gadi un kurš studējis ārzemēs, pārsteidza novērotājus, parādoties civiliem apģērbos, nevis jaunajā četru zvaigžņu ģenerāļa formā. Ar plašu nabadzību un ekonomisko kritumu daudzi parastie ziemeļkorejieši varētu cīnīties ar to, kā šī izdevīgā parāde iekļaujas viņu ikdienas grūtībās. Ķīnas prezidents Hu Džintao nosūtīja sveicienu, slavējot Ziemeļkorejas 'sociālistiskās panākumus' un atkārtoti apsolot Pekinas saistības stiprināt abpusējos attiecības. article_content: Bangkok (CNN) — No parent should ever have to bury their child. Yet in recent days, that harrowing reality has struck families in Thailand as political unrest turns deadly — even for the youngest among us. Children, caught in the crossfire of violence, have been killed or severely injured by shrapnel and bullets during protests. In Bangkok’s Ratchaprasong district, a grenade exploded near an anti-government rally outside a shopping mall, killing a six-year-old girl, a four-year-old boy, and a woman in her 40s. In eastern Trat province, a five-year-old girl was fatally struck by a stray bullet during another demonstration. The two children in Bangkok — siblings nicknamed 'Cake' and 'Kane' — were with their aunt and cousin on a rare family outing. They were waiting for a tuk-tuk when the blast occurred. Cake and Kane died at the scene. Their eight-year-old cousin remains in critical condition. Their father, Thayakorn Yotubon, a personal assistant and driver, described his children as loving, gentle souls who adored being with their parents. He recalled how Cake had asked him to buy her a T-shirt that read, 'I love Papa' — meant to be worn on Father’s Day. At their funeral, he held the shirt close, weeping. The mother, overcome with grief, could barely speak or lift her head. When she was helped to stand and approach their bodies — bandaged, still, unrecognizable in their stillness — she cried, 'These are not my children. They don’t look like that.' The funeral followed Buddhist tradition: water poured over tiny hands to signify returning the soul to nature. But these were not the hands of an elder — they were the fragile, innocent hands of children. The mother could not bear to look at their faces. Even the monk stood silent, moved beyond words. Family and friends, too devastated to offer condolences, simply wept. Thayakorn fell to his knees, whispering, 'You were too young to die.' Though the family welcomed media coverage, the cameraman paused, questioning whether documenting such raw pain was appropriate. But as Thayakorn said: 'My kids were just children. They had nothing to do with this.' Their deaths are not statistics — they are a mirror held up to the cost of division.
translated_content: Bangkokas (CNN) — Neviens vecāks nevajadzētu būt spiestam apbedīt savu bērnu. Tomēr pēdējās dienās šis satriecošais realitāte ir skārusi ķīniešu ģimenes, kad politiskā nestabilitāte kļuvusi nāvīga — pat jaunākajiem no mums. Bērni, kuri nonākuši vardarbības krustugunī, ir nogalināti vai nopietni ievainoti ar šrapneli un šāvieniem protestu laikā. Bangkokas rajonā Ratchaprasong granāta uzspridza tuvu antivlādībai vērstai demonstrācijai ārpus veikala, nogalinot seš gadus vecu meiteni, četr gadus vecu zēnu un sievieti aptuveni 40 gados. Austrumos, Trat provincē, piecu gadu veca meitene tika nogalināta ar nejaušu šāvienu citā demonstrācijā. Abi bērni Bangkokā — brālis un māsa, kuriem bija dēvējvārdi 'Cake' un 'Kane' — bija ar savu teitu un kuzīniem uz retas ģimenes izbraukuma. Viņi gaidīja tuk-tuk, kad notika sprādziens. Cake un Kane mira vietas vietā. To astoņu gadu vecais kuzīnis joprojām atrodas kritiskā stāvoklī. To tēvs, Tejakorns Jotubons, personaļais asistents un braucējs, aprakstīja savus bērnus kā mīlošus, maigus būtnes, kas milzīgi mīlēja pavadīt laiku ar vecākiem. Viņš atcerējās, kā Cake bija lūgusi nopirkt viņai kreklu ar uzrakstu 'I love Papa' — paredzēts tikt uzvilktam uz Tēva dienas. Apbedīšanas ceremonijā viņš turēja to kreklu pie krūtīm, plūdot asaras. Māte, pārņemta žēlsirdības, varēja tikai ļoti nelielu galvu pacelt vai iztīrīt asaras. Kad viņu palīdzēja nostāvēt un tuvoties viņu ķermeņiem — apsaišķētiem, klusimi, neatpazīstamiem — viņa izsaucās: 'Tie nav mani bērni. Viņi neizskatās tā.' Apbedīšana notika pēc budistu tradīcijām: ūdens tiek ielejams caur rokām, lai simbolizētu ķermeņa atgriešanos dabā. Bet šīs nebija vecāka rokas — tās bija trauslas, nevainojamas bērnu rokas. Māte nevarēja skatīties viņu sejās. Pat budisma mūks stāvēja kluss, pārsteigts līdz vārdu trūkumam. Ģimenes locekļi un draugi, pārāk izsalcīgi, lai sniegtu piedošanu, vienkārši raudāja. Tejakorns nokrita ceļos un šausmās šausminājās: 'Jūs bijāt pārāk jauni, lai mirtu.' Lai gan ģimene atbalstīja mediju klātbūtni, kameravads pārdomāja, vai dokumentēt šādu pārsteidzošu sāpju bija pareizi. Bet kā Tejakorns teica: 'Mani bērni bija vienkārši bērni. Viņiem nebija nekā kopīga ar šo politisko jautājumu.' Viņu nāves nav statistika — tās ir spogulis, kas atspoguļo sadalīšanās cenu.

article_content: Baghdad (CNN) — A series of bombings struck Baghdad on Sunday, killing at least 21 people and wounding 125 others, according to police. The attacks — six car bombs and three roadside explosives — primarily targeted outdoor markets in Shiite neighborhoods, Baghdad police said. Overall violence in Iraq has declined significantly since the peak of sectarian conflict between 2005 and 2007. Yet such attacks persist as the 10th anniversary of the U.S.-led invasion approaches next month. The U.S. Embassy in Baghdad condemned the bombings. Recent attacks in Shiite areas have fueled fears among Iraqis that sectarian violence could resurge. Sunnis demand that the Shiite-led government end what they describe as systemic discrimination against Iraq’s Sunni population. Many Sunnis boycotted the 2005 national elections, leading to the rise of a Shiite-dominated government and leaving the former ruling minority feeling marginalized. Last month, at least 177 Iraqi civilians, soldiers, and police officers were killed in attacks, according to figures from Iraq’s Interior, Defense, and Health Ministries. The vast majority of victims were civilians, the ministries reported. The tally does not include deaths in Iraq’s semi-autonomous Kurdish region, which maintains separate casualty records. Security has deteriorated since December, when Sunni protesters in provinces such as Anbar and Mosul demanded an end to what they called discriminatory policies. The demonstrations were triggered after Iraqi security forces arrested several bodyguards of Finance Minister Rafie al-Essawi, a Sunni.
translated_content: Bagdāda (CNN) — Svētdien Bagdādē notika vairāki uzbrukumi ar bumbām, kas nogalināja vismaz 21 cilvēku un ievainoja 125 citus, paziņoja policija. Uzbrukumi — sešas automašīnbumbas un trīs sānceļa sprādzieni — galvenokārt mērķēja ārējās tirgus vietas šiītu apkaimēs, sacīja Bagdādes policija. Vispārējā vardarbība Irākā ir nozīmīgi samazinājusies kopš sektoru konfliktu virsotnes 2005.–2007. gadā. Tomēr šādi uzbrukumi turpinās, jo ASV vadītās Irākas iebrukuma 10. gadadiena tuvojas nākamajā mēnesī. ASV vēstniecība Bagdādē apsodīja šos uzbrukumus. Nesenie uzbrukumi šiītu rajonos ir izraisījuši bažas starp iedzīvotājiem, ka sektoru karš var atkārtoties. Suni vēlas, lai šiītu vadītā valdība pārtrauc to, ko viņi apraksta kā sistēmisku diskrimināciju pret Irākas sunnu populāciju. Daudzi sunni boikotēja 2005. gada nacionālās vēlēšanas, kas noveda pie šiītu dominējošas valdības izveidošanas un atstāja agrāko valdījošo minoritāti izmisumā. Pagājušajā mēnesī vismaz 177 irākiešu civiliedzīvotāji, armijas un policijas darbinieki tika nogalināti uzbrukumos, pēc datiem no Irākas Iekšlietu, Aizsardzības un Veselības ministrijām. Lielākā daļa upuru bija civildzīvotāji, ziņoja ministrijas. Šis skaitlis neiekļauj nāves gadījumus Irākas pusautonomajā Kurdistānā, kas uztur savus nāves reģistrus. Drošība ir pasliktinājusies kopš decembra, kad sunnu demonstranti provincēs, piemēram, Anbārā un Mosūlā, prasīja pārtraukt to, ko viņi sauca par diskriminatīvām politikām. Demonstrācijas tika izraisītas, kad irākiešu drošības spēki arestēja finanšu ministra Rafie al-Essawi, sunnu, vairākus ķermeņa aizsargus.

article_content: Former Labour MP Margaret Moran has been declared mentally unfit to stand trial over allegations she fraudulently claimed £80,000 in parliamentary expenses. Court-appointed psychiatrists say she is suffering from severe depression, crippling anxiety, and recurring suicidal thoughts—symptoms that intensified after her political career collapsed under the weight of the scandal. Doctors noted she feels deeply abandoned by her own party and describes her current state as being 'a broken woman.' Moran, 56, is accused of repeatedly changing her declared second home to justify claims for home improvements in London, Luton, and Southampton—including £22,500 for dry rot repairs at a property originally owned by her husband, Michael Booker, located over 100 miles from her constituency. Additional claims include £4,756 for kitchen fittings and nearly £15,000 for emergency boiler work and a conservatory renovation. Forensic psychiatrist Dr. Philip Joseph testified that Moran’s mental health deteriorates dramatically when discussing the case, impairing her memory and concentration. All three independent psychiatric evaluations concluded she cannot meaningfully engage in legal proceedings. He described how her once vibrant persona vanished after losing her seat, leaving her physically and emotionally shattered. Though Moran reportedly told a psychiatrist, 'I just want to plead guilty and be punished,' the judge believes she hasn’t fully grasped the gravity of her actions. As a result, the case will proceed without her presence. A jury at Southwark Crown Court in London will hear the evidence this November. Moran is the fifth Labour MP to face criminal charges in the 2009 expenses scandal. Four others—David Chaytor, Eric Illsley, Elliot Morley, and Jim Devine—were imprisoned. Two Conservative peers, Lords Taylor of Warwick and Hanningfield, were also jailed.
translated_content: Bijuvais Labour deputāts Margarita Morāna ir uzskatīta par garīgi neiespējamo stāties tiesā par apsūdzībām, ka viņa krāpti izmantoja 80 000 lielās britu mārciņas parlamentāros izdevumos. Psihiatri, kas tika iecelti tiesas, saka, ka viņa cieš no smagas depresijas, nevaldāmas bažām un atkārtotiem pašnāvības domām — simptomus, kas intensīvāki kļuva pēc tās politiskās karjeras beigām skandāla dēļ. Ārsti piezīmēja, ka viņa jūtas dziļi atstāta savas partijas puses un apraksta savu pašreizējo stāvokli kā 'sabrukušu sievieti.' Morāna, 56 gadu veca, tiek apsūdzēta, ka atkārtoti mainīja savu deklarēto otrās mājas statusu, lai pamatotu prasības mājas remontam Londonā, Lutonā un Soutampjonā — tostarp 22 500 lielās mārciņas sauszemes kaitējuma novēršanai īpašumā, kas sākotnēji piederēja viņas vīram, Mihaelam Būkeram, un atrodas vairāk nekā 160 km no viņas vēlētāju apgabala. Papildus prasības ietver 4756 lielās mārciņas virtuves iekārtām un gandrīz 15 000 lielās mārciņas avārijas katlu darbiem un verandas remontam. Forenziķis psihiatrs Doks Filips Džozefs liecināja, ka Morānas garīgais veselības stāvoklis dramatiski pasliktinās, kad viņa runā par lietu, traucējot atmiņu un koncentrāciju. Visi trīs neatkarīgie psihiatriskie novērtējumi secināja, ka viņa nevar nozīmīgi iesaistīties tiesvedībā. Viņš aprakstīja, kā viņas bijušais dzīvs personīgums pazuda pēc mandāta zaudēšanas, atstājot viņu fiziķiski un emocionāli sabrukušu. Kaut arī Morāna paziņoja psihiatram: 'Es tikai gribu atzīt vainu un sodu,' tiesnesis uzskata, ka viņa nav pilnībā uztvērusi savu rīcības nopietnību. Tāpēc lieta tiks izskatīta bez viņas klātbūtnes. Žūrija Southwark Crown Court Londonā klausīs pierādījumus novembrī. Morāna ir piektā Labour partijas deputāte, kas tiek sodīta par 2009. gada izdevumu skandālu. Citi četri — Deivids Čeitors, Eriks Ilzlijs, Eliots Morlijs un Džims Devins — tika nosūtīti cietumā. Divi Konservatīvo partijas locekļi, lordi Teylors no Vārvika un Heningfields, arī tika nosūtīti cietumā.

article_content: On a cold December morning in 2010, Alan Catterall, a 54-year-old father of three and respected team leader at Pyranha Mouldings, climbed inside an industrial oven to fix a malfunction. Unbeknownst to his future son-in-law, Mark Francis — who was operating the machine — Catterall was still inside when Francis turned it on. Without warning, the oven’s power-operated doors slammed shut and locked with heavy metal bolts. There was no alarm. No emergency release. Just silence, despite the deafening noise of the factory floor. Catterall, desperate to survive, used a crowbar to try to pry open the door. But the roar of machinery drowned out his cries. It wasn’t until smoke began curling from the oven’s seams that coworkers realized something was terribly wrong. By then, it was too late. Catterall had suffered catastrophic burns and died from shock. The oven, used to cure plastic for kayak production, reached temperatures of 280°C. Designed by self-employed engineer Paul Keddie and owned by Pyranha Mouldings, it lacked basic safety features common in industrial equipment. Now, the company’s directors, Graham and Peter Mackereth, along with Keddie, face criminal charges for alleged failures in workplace safety — including corporate manslaughter. Catterall had spent over a decade at Pyranha after working for Ford and earlier at a tyre factory. His wife and daughter also worked alongside him. His death exposed deep flaws in a system that prioritized operational efficiency over worker safety — and cost a loving father his life.
translated_content: 2010. gada aukstā decembra rītā Alans Keteralis, 54 gadus vecs trīs bērnu tēvs un cienīts komandas vadītājs uzņēmumā Pyranha Mouldings, iekāpa industriālajā krāsnī, lai novērstu kļūdu. Nezinot, ka viņš vēl joprojām bija iekšā, viņa nākotnes dēla draugs, Marks Frānsiss, kas darbojās ar ierīci, ieslēdza krāsni. Bez brīdinājuma krāsns spēka darbināmās durvis aizslēdzās un nostiprinājās ar smagiem metāla pārslām. Nebija nekāda brīdinājuma. Nebija nekādas avārijas iziešanas iespējas. Tikai klusums, neskatoties uz rūpnīcas troksni. Keteralis, cenšoties izglābties, izmantoja dzelzs stieni, lai mēģinātu izcelt durvis. Bet mašīnu troksnis noslāba viņa saucienus. Tikai tad, kad no krāsns šuvēm sāka izkļūt dūmi, kolēģi apjēdza, ka kaut kas ir ļoti nepareizi. Tas bija par vēlu. Keteralis bija ciets nopietnus apdegumus un mira no šoka. Krāsns, ko izmantoja plastmasas kajaku ražošanai, sasniedza temperatūru līdz 280 °C. To projektoja pašnodarbinātais elektroinženieris Pols Keddijs, un to īpašnieks bija Pyranha Mouldings. Tā nebija aprīkota ar pamata drošības funkcijām, kas ir parastas industriālajā iekārtā. Tagad uzņēmuma vadītāji, Graham un Pīters Makerseti, kopā ar Keddijsu, tiek sodīti par apsūdzībām saistībā ar darba drošības pārkāpumiem — ieskaitot korporatīvo nogalināšanu. Keteralis ilgus gadus strādāja uzņēmumā Pyranha, pirms tam strādājis Ford un agrāk riepu rūpnīcā. Viņa sieva un meita arī strādāja blakus viņam. Viņa nāve atklāja dziļas trūkstības sistēmā, kas prioritizēja darbības efektivitāti pār darbinieku drošību — un izmaksāja mīlošam tēvam dzīvību.

article_content: Rape allegations against Bill Cosby resurfaced dramatically on Monday when a seemingly innocuous social media campaign backfired. Barbara Bowman, 47, a survivor of Cosby’s alleged sexual abuse, told MailOnline in an exclusive interview: 'I do not find rape funny—but I also don’t ridicule others for their expression. Cosby’s self-induced #cosbymeme became a platform for many to voice their outrage.' On Monday afternoon, Cosby posted a Twitter invitation asking fans to create memes using selected photos of himself—likely intending lighthearted content like 'Happy Monday!' But instead, users flooded the feed with references to the dozens of sexual assault allegations against him. Bowman, an artist and former actress, came forward following comedian Hannibal Buress’s 2015 onstage denunciation of Cosby as a rapist. 'I was drugged and raped by that man,' she told MailOnline. She described the viral meme phenomenon as a powerful moment of collective reckoning. 'I’m grateful the public is finally paying attention to the truth about Bill Cosby and his crimes.' 'Rape isn’t something to joke about,' Bowman added, 'but Twitter has become a vessel for expressing profound disgust—and giving voice to those silenced for too long.' Although Cosby has never been criminally convicted of rape, the public backlash was swift. His original tweet was deleted, and the meme generator was removed from his website, redirecting visitors to his homepage. Yet the memes continue to circulate across social platforms. Over the past three decades, more than a dozen women have accused Cosby of drugging and sexually assaulting them. In 2006, he settled a civil lawsuit with Andrea Constand, a former Temple University employee, who alleged he assaulted her in 2004. At that trial, 13 other women testified about similar experiences. Bowman recounted how, as a teenager, Cosby flew her across the country, hosted her in luxury hotels, and then allegedly drugged and assaulted her after she passed out following a glass of wine. By age 19, she says he cut ties after another attempted assault in Atlantic City. 'He came at me like a monster,' Bowman said. 'My hope is that other survivors won’t stay silent because their abusers are famous or powerful. If I help even one person speak up, I’ve done my job.' Cosby, best known for playing Dr. Cliff Huxtable on The Cosby Show, has remained publicly silent since the allegations resurfaced. Despite his Emmy- and Grammy-winning legacy, he continues to face widespread condemnation.

Cosby paša izveidotais #cosbymeme kļuva par plašu iespēju daudziem izteikt savu ļaunumu.' Pirmdien pēcpusdienā Cosby publiskēja Twitter ziņu, aicinot fanus izveidot memus, izmantojot dažādas viņa bildes — iespējams, domājot vieglus, jokainus ierakstus, piemēram, 'Lai būtu laimīga pirmdiena!' Lai gan Cosby nekad nav sodīts tiesas ceļā par apziedēšanu, sabiedriskā reakcija bija ātra. Viņa sākotnējā ziņa tika dzēsta, un memes ģenerators tika noņemts no viņa vietnes, pāradresējot apmeklētājus uz viņa mājaslapu. Tomēr memi turpinās izplatīties citās sociālajās platformās. Pēdējo trīs dekāžu laikā vairāk nekā desmit sievietes apsūdz Cosby par to, ka viņš ir apdzēris un seksuāli uzbrucis. 2006. gadā viņš risināja civillietu ar Andrea Constand, bijušo Temple Universitātes darbinieci, kas apliecina, ka Cosby viņu uzbruka 2004. gadā savā Filadelfijas piederošumā. Šajā procesā 13 citas sievietes apliecina, ka arī tām ir noticis līdzīgs notikums. Bowman stāstīja, ka, kad viņa bija jauna meitenīte, Cosby viņu lidoja pa visu valsti, ievietoja luksusa viesnīcās, un tad, pēc tam, kad viņa zaudēja apziņu pēc glāzes vīna, viņš, iespējams, apdzēra un apziedēja viņu. 19 gadu vecumā viņa saka, ka viņš pārtrauca attiecības pēc vēl viena mēģinājuma uzbrukt viņai Atlantikas krastā. article_content: On August 4, 2011, Mark Duggan, a 29-year-old man, was shot and killed by armed police in Tottenham, North London — an event that ignited widespread riots across the city and beyond. A key eyewitness, known only as Witness B to protect his identity, testified at the inquest that Duggan was holding a mobile phone in his hand when he was fatally shot. Witness B stated he saw Duggan collapse after being struck twice, with the officer who fired standing five to seven steps away. Using his own phone, Witness B filmed the moments after the shooting. The footage was later shared with the BBC and shown to jurors during the inquest at the Royal Courts of Justice, where more than 50 members of the public watched via video link. Witness B described hearing screeching tires and shouts of 'put it down' before seeing armed officers in blue jackets surround Duggan, who was standing on the sidewalk. He recalled Duggan appearing 'baffled,' with his hands raised, palms facing the officers, and a phone clearly clutched in his right hand. When asked if Duggan appeared to be surrendering, Witness B replied without hesitation: 'Yes. None whatsoever.' Witness B admitted he had been reluctant to testify and relocated outside London due to fear for his safety. He cited the traumatic nature of witnessing a fatal shooting and rumors of gang involvement as reasons for his anxiety. He also acknowledged that the BBC compensated him for the footage, though he insisted the motivation was not financial: 'I just wanted it out there.' During cross-examination, defense counsel questioned whether Witness B had initially mistaken the phone for a gun. Witness B firmly maintained he recognized it as a BlackBerry due to his '20/20 vision,' despite viewing the scene from approximately 150 meters away. The inquest revealed that police had been monitoring Duggan as part of an investigation into a firearms-related gang. However, Witness B’s account directly contradicted the suggestion that Duggan posed an imminent threat. The emotional testimony prompted spontaneous applause from spectators in the courtroom. The inquest was adjourned until the next day.

Viens no svarīgākajiem lieciniekiem, kas pazīstams kā Liecinieks B, lai aizsargātu viņa anonimitāti, liecināja izmeklēšanā, ka Duggans turēja mobilo telefona ierīci rokā, kad viņš tika nāvīgi ievainots. Liecinieks B teica, ka redzējis, kā Duggans krīt uz ielas virsmas pēc divām ievainojumiem, kamēr šāvējs stāv piecus līdz septiņus soļus attālumā. Liecinieks B aprakstīja, ka dzirdējis riepu skrējienu un saucienus 'nolaižiet to', pirms redzējis bruņotos policistus zilās jakās, kas apseguši Dugganu, kas atradās uz ielas malas. Uz jautājumu, vai Duggans izskatījās kā nododamies, Liecinieks B atbildēja bez šaubām: 'Jā. Nav nekādu šaubu.' Liecinieks B atzina, ka bija nelabprātīgs liecināt un pārcēlies ārpus Londona dēļ drošības bažām. Liecinieks B stingri uzturēja, ka viņš atpazina to kā BlackBerry, izmantojot savu '20/20 redzi', neskatoties uz to, ka skatījās no aptuveni 150 metru attāluma. Izmelešana atklāja, ka policija bija novērojusi Dugganu kā daļu no izmeklēšanas par ieroču izmantošanas bandu. Tomēr Liecinieka B apliecinājums tieši pretrunāja ar domu, ka Duggans radīja nekavējamu bīstamību. Emocionālais liecinājums izraisīja spontānu applausu no skatītājiem tiesas zālē. article_content: As the world eagerly awaits the official unveiling of the iPhone 6 on September 9, a unique phenomenon is unfolding outside Apple’s flagship store in New York: people are camping out for weeks—not just out of excitement, but for pay. Among them are Jason and Moon Ray, a married couple from Austin, Texas, who’ve set up camp with tents, sleeping bags, and a solar charger, all thanks to sponsorship from a startup called Video Medicine. In exchange for wearing branded apparel and sharing their experience online, the couple is having their trip covered—and they’ll walk away with a brand-new iPhone once it launches on September 19. They’re not alone. Joseph Cruz, a seasoned queue veteran from Staten Island, has been lining up for Apple releases for five straight years. This year, he secured the top two spots alongside his cousin, also sponsored by tech firms. For Cruz, it’s less about the phone and more about the experience—and the perks. 'We get free food, a free iPhone, and $1,250 in cash,' he says with a grin. 'What’s not to love?' Behind the scenes, rumors are flying: the iPhone 6 is expected to feature a larger display, significantly improved battery life, and a next-gen Wi-Fi chip promising blazing-fast speeds. Leaked images and specs have only intensified the buzz. Meanwhile, Apple’s Fifth Avenue storefront has become a makeshift festival, with fans from across the country turning a product launch into a multi-week social event—funded, filmed, and filtered by corporate sponsors.

article_content: Raymond van Barneveld clinched his first Premier League Darts title after stunning favorite Michael van Gerwen at the O2 Arena in London on Thursday. Despite failing to advance beyond the semifinals in six previous attempts, Van Barneveld secured a surprising 10-6 victory over the world No. 1 in an all-Dutch final, claiming the trophy and £150,000 in prize money. Van Gerwen opened strong by winning the first leg, but Van Barneveld responded with momentum, racing to a 3-1 lead. After the break, Van Barneveld extended his advantage to 5-3. Van Gerwen fought back to level the score, but Van Barneveld regained control, pulling ahead by four legs with victory in sight. Van Gerwen briefly rallied to stay alive, but Van Barneveld held firm. A timely 180 put him in position to seal the win, which he did with a double 10. Van Barneveld reached the final after defeating Phil Taylor 8-5 in the semifinals, while Van Gerwen edged past Gary Anderson in a thrilling 15-leg contest.

Van Gerwen sāka spēli ar spēcīgu startu, uzvarot pirmo kārtu, taču Van Barneveld atbildēja ar impulsu, iegūstot 3-1 priekšroku. Pēc pārtraukuma Van Barneveld paplašināja savu priekšrocību līdz 5-3. Van Gerwen cīnījās atpakaļ, lai līdzsvarotu rezultātu, bet Van Barneveld atkal ieguva kontroli, izveidojot četru kārtu priekšrocību, kad uzvara bija redzama. Van Gerwen īsi atgriezās spēlē, taču Van Barneveld saglabāja paškontroli. Laicīgs 180 nodrošināja viņam iespēju noslēgt uzvaru, ko viņš paveica ar dubultu 10. Van Barneveld nonāca finālā, pēc 8-5 uzvaras pār Filu Teyloru pusfinālā, bet Van Gerwen uzvarēja Gari Andersonu aizraujošā 15-kārtu cīņā.

article_content: For years, scientists puzzled over why even the fastest birds can't dodge jets and high-speed vehicles — until now. New research reveals birds don’t calculate how fast something is coming at them; they only react based on how close it is. This simple rule works fine against slow predators, but fails catastrophically against cars, trucks, and planes traveling faster than 75 mph (120 km/h). In a groundbreaking experiment, researchers from the USDA, Indiana State University, and Purdue University used virtual reality to safely observe brown-headed cowbirds reacting to video simulations of vehicles racing toward them at speeds up to 224 mph — covering everything from highway cars to commercial jet takeoffs. The birds consistently waited until the vehicle was about 30 meters (98 feet) away before taking flight — no matter how fast it was moving. That delay becomes deadly at higher speeds. At 120 km/h, 30 meters gives birds less than a second to react — not nearly enough time to gain altitude or change direction. As a result, tens of thousands of birds die annually in collisions, and aircraft face serious risks: bird impacts can shatter windshields, disable engines, and even cause crashes. The FAA estimates 9,000 bird strikes occur each year in the U.S. alone — and that’s likely an undercount, since many go unreported. The consequences are severe. A single 5-kilogram goose hitting a plane at 240 km/h generates the same force as a 454-kilogram weight falling from three meters. Since 1988, bird strikes have contributed to over 200 human deaths worldwide. While only about a third of strikes cause major damage, the toll on wildlife is immense. One of the most famous incidents occurred in 2009, when US Airways Flight 1549 lost both engines after hitting a flock of geese and made a miraculous water landing in the Hudson River. The financial impact is staggering: $400 million in damages annually in the U.S., and up to $1.2 billion globally. But hope remains. Scientists believe these birds aren’t 'stupid' — their evasion strategy evolved for natural threats, not human-made machines. The solution? Equip aircraft with bright, flashing lights that could signal danger from farther away, giving birds more time to respond. Further studies are needed to see if other bird species behave similarly — but if this works, it could save countless lives, both avian and human.

Jaunā pētījuma rezultāti atklāj, ka putni nesaprata, cik ātri kaut kas tuvojas; tie reaģē tikai atkarībā no tā, cik tuvu tas ir. Šis vienkāršais likums darbojas labi pret lēniem ienaidniekiem, bet katastrofāli neizdodas pret automobiļiem, kravas automobiļiem un lidmašīnām, kas brauc ātrāk par 120 km/h. Revolucionārā eksperimentā pētnieki no USDA, Indijanas Valsts universitātes un Purdu universitātes izmantoja virtuālo realitāti, lai droši novērotu brūno galvu kovbirtu reakcijas uz video simulācijām, kurās transportlīdzekļi brauca uz tiem ar ātrumu līdz 360 km/h — aptverot visu no autoceļu automobiļiem līdz komerciālo lidmašīnu pacelšanās ātrumam. Putni vienmēr gaidīja, līdz transportlīdzeklis atradās apmēram 30 metru (98 pēdu) attālumā, pirms sāka lidot — neatkarīgi no tā, cik ātri tas kustējās. Šis kavēšanās kļūst nāvīgs lielākos ātrumos. Pie 120 km/h, 30 metri dod putniem mazāk par sekundi, lai reaģētu — nepietiekami daudz laika, lai iegūtu augstumu vai mainītu virzienu. Tā rezultātā ik gadu tūkstošiem putnu nomirst sadursmēs, un lidmašīnām radās nopietni riski: putnu trieciens var saplīst vēja aizsargu, izslēgt motorus un pat izraisīt avārijas. FAA novērtē, ka ASV katru gadu notiek 9000 putnu sadursmes — un šis skaitlis ir droši vien zems, jo daudzas neuzrauga. Pārsteidzošās sekas. Viens vienīgs 5 kg svars gāze, kas trāpa lidmašīnu ar ātrumu 240 km/h, radīs tādu pašu spēku kā 454 kg svars, kas nokrīt no 3 metru augstuma. Kopš 1988. gada putnu sadursmes ir iegādājušās vairāk nekā 200 cilvēku dzīvības visā pasaulē. Līdz pat trešdaļai sadursmju izraisa lielu bojājumu, taču putnu zaudējumi ir milzīgi. Viena no slavenākajām avārijām notika 2009. gadā, kad US Airways lidmašīna 1549 zaudēja abus motorus pēc gāzu baras trieciena un veica brīnumainu nosēšanos Hjadsonas upē. Finansiālie zaudējumi ir aplēsīgi: katru gadu ASV notiek 400 miljonu dolāru bojājumi, bet globāli līdz 1,2 miljardiem dolāru. Bet cerība joprojām pastāv. Pētnieki uzskata, ka šie putni nav 'stulbi' — to izbēgšanas stratēģija attīstījusies pret dabiskām briesmām, nevis cilvēka radītām mašīnām. Risinājums? Aprīkot lidmašīnas ar spilgtiem, mirgojošiem gaismas signāliem, kas varētu brīdināt putnus no lielāka attāluma, dodot tiem vairāk laika reaģēt. Vajag papildu pētījumus, lai uzzinātu, vai citi putnu sugas rīkojas līdzīgi — bet ja šis risinājums strādā, tas varētu glābt ne tikai putnu, bet arī cilvēku dzīvības.

article_content: For generations, the British pub has been cherished as a cornerstone of national culture — a place for camaraderie, pints, and tradition. But a surprising new theory, backed by decades of research, suggests its roots might not be British at all. According to Ted Bruning, a seasoned drinks historian and author, the earliest public drinking spaces in England weren’t cozy alehouses serving barley brews — they were French-run wine bars in the heart of medieval London. After the Norman invasion of 1066, William the Conqueror’s forces brought with them a wave of French merchants who needed places to rest and refresh during trade along the River Thames. These traders gathered at The Vintry, a bustling wharf lined with wine warehouses. Recognizing demand, local entrepreneurs began serving wine by the glass to sailors and merchants — essentially creating the first establishments that matched the modern definition of a pub. Bruning, who spent 30 years tracing the history of Britain’s oldest drinking spots, points out that no credible records exist of similar public venues before the Normans. The first true alehouse — one brewing and selling beer — didn’t appear until 1212, following the Great Fire of Southwark, when safety records mention beer-selling premises for the first time. In his new book, *Merrie England: The Medieval Roots of the Great British Pub*, Bruning doesn’t claim absolute proof — but he does argue that, given the lack of alternatives, the Normans are the most plausible originators. For beer lovers and pub purists, it’s a hard pill to swallow: the iconic British institution may have begun as a wine bar run by French merchants in the City of London.

article_content: NFL player DeAngelo Williams generously gave up his business-class seat to a man he believed was a Marine during a Delta Airlines flight. On Monday morning, the Carolina Panthers running back shared a photo of his boarding pass alongside an image of the man in military uniform on Twitter and Facebook. 'I always give up my seat to military personnel if mine is better!' Williams wrote. 'I truly appreciate our troops.' He noted that the individual was unaware of the gesture. 'He doesn’t know it yet, but he’ll be sitting in this seat when he boards the plane. I always give up my first-class seat! #IStandWithTheTroops.' While many fans praised Williams for his kindness, others raised concerns about the man’s uniform. Critics pointed out apparent violations of Marine Corps protocol: the man was seen wearing his cap indoors and displaying a shooting badge on the right breast pocket — both inconsistent with standard regulations. One Facebook user, Eric Knight, commented, 'Unfortunately, this guy is disrespecting the Marine Corps uniform. No Marine wears a cover indoors, and shooting badges aren’t worn with medals on the right pocket.' Another user, Justin Amos, stated, 'I’m a Marine, and he’s wearing his cover inside. No Marine wears their cover indoors. Something is fishy, DeAngelo — don’t give up your seat to him!' However, others urged caution against judgment. Nicole Marie responded, 'Even if he isn’t really a Marine, why focus on the negative? DeAngelo did something respectable. It reflects his character — and it’s not his fault if this guy wasn’t legitimately in uniform.' Williams defended his decision to post publicly, writing, 'I always do this. For those saying I shouldn’t have posted: keep calm and enjoy my page. Happy Fourth of July — it’s called being patriotic for life.' The incident follows a similar act by actress Amy Adams, who quietly exchanged her first-class seat with a soldier on a Delta flight from Detroit to Los Angeles. Adams, whose father served in the military, told Inside Edition: 'I didn’t do it for attention for myself. I did it for attention for the troops.'

'Es vienmēr atdošu savu sēdvietu karaspēkam, ja mana ir labāka!' rakstīja Viljams. 'Es ļoti cienu mūsu karavīrus.' Viņš piezīmēja, ka šis cilvēks nezināja par šo žestu. Šis notikums seko līdzīgam darbam, ko veica aktrise Emi Adams, kas klusi maiņāja savu pirmās klases sēdvietu ar karavīru Delta lidojumā no Detrolas līdz Losandželosai. article_content: A small plane crashed in a remote area of Alaska, miles from the village of St. Mary’s, on a dark, foggy Friday night. Rescuers struggled to locate the wreckage of the Cessna, which carried 10 passengers. Despite severe injuries and the urgent need to care for her 5-month-old son, 25-year-old survivor Melanie Coffee managed to crawl half a mile across slippery tundra to reach the town’s landfill—where she encountered a search party of 40 to 50 villagers and calmly guided them back to the crash site. Tragically, four people—including her infant son, Wyatt Coffee—died from their injuries. Others suffered head trauma and multiple fractures. Paramedic Clifford Dalton of LifeMed Alaska said Coffee’s actions were critical: 'The fact that she could make it out to an identifiable landmark really helped to expedite the aid that the rest of the patients were able to receive.' He added, 'What’s really remarkable is that she was tending to her infant child that was gravely injured at the time.' After the crash, Coffee called the on-call health aide in St. Mary’s, a community of just 500 people. Fred Lamont Jr. confirmed she was attempting CPR on her baby. Six to eight villagers carried each survivor to the landfill, the closest point accessible by ambulance. Residents from Mountain Village, 25 miles away, also rushed to assist, as most victims were from there. The National Transportation Safety Board has not yet determined the cause of the crash. Hageland Aviation Flight 1453 departed Bethel at 5:40 p.m. and went down roughly four miles from the St. Mary’s airport. Company president Jim Hickerson stated, 'Hageland is working to gather information to answer questions and do what we can to ease the suffering of those involved in the accident. As a family-owned business, this is an unspeakable tragedy for us.' The deceased include pilot Terry Hanson, 68; Richard Polty, 65; Rose Polty, 57; and Wyatt Coffee, 5 months. Four injured individuals remain hospitalized in fair condition: Pauline Johnson, 37; Shannon Lawrence; Tanya Lawrence, 35; and Garrette Moses, 30. Fourteen-year-old Kylan Johnson was treated and released. Melanie Coffee, also in fair condition, is not giving interviews. Alaska relies heavily on air transport due to its lack of road infrastructure. According to CDC data, about 35% of all U.S. commuter plane and air taxi crashes between 1990 and 2009 occurred in Alaska.
translated_content: Mazais lidmašīnas tipa Cessna krita ļoti attālā, neieejamā Alaskas daļā, daudzas jūdzes no ciemata St. Mary’s, tumšā un miglainā piektdienas vakarā. Glābšanas darbi bija sarežģīti, jo nevarēja precīzi noteikt avārijas vietas. Glābēji varēja dzirdēt izdzīvojušo Melāniju Kofi, kas zvanīja pa telefonu, taču sliktā laika apstākļos tas bija kā adatas meklēšana kaudzē. Tomēr 25 gadus vecā Kofi, pat ar nopietniem ievainojumiem un bērnu rokās, veica pusi jūrmalas caur slīpo, izslīdējošu tundru un nonāca ciemata atkritumu kaudzē, kur satika 40–50 vietējos meklētājus un mierīgi novadīja viņus uz avārijas vietu. Cetri cilvēki, ieskaitot viņas 5 mēnešus veco dēlu Vaitiju, mira no ievainojumiem. Pārējie bija ar galvas traumām un vairākiem salauztām kauliem. Paramedi Clifford Daltons no LifeMed Alaska sacīja: 'Fakts, ka viņa spēja nonākt līdz identificējamam punktam, ļoti palīdzēja ātrāk nodrošināt palīdzību pārējiem pacientiem.' Viņš piebilda: 'Visvairāk brīnišķīgi ir tas, ka viņa rūpējās par sava zīdaiņa, kas bija nopietni ievainots, laikā.' Pēc avārijas Kofi zvanīja St. Mary’s, kas sastāv no 500 iedzīvotājiem, uzraudzības palīgam Fredam Lamontam Jr. Viņš apstiprināja, ka Kofi mēģināja veikt CPR savam zīdaiņam. Seši līdz astoņi vietējie iedzīvotāji nesa katru izdzīvojušo uz atkritumu kaudzi — tuvāko punktu, kur varēja nonākt ātrās palīdzības mašīnas. No kalnu ciemata, 25 jūdzes attālumā, arī nāca palīdzēt, jo lielākā daļa upuru bija no turienes. Nacionālā transporta drošības padome vēl nevar noteikt avārijas cēloni. Hageland Aviation lidmašīna 1453 izlidoja no Betela plkst. 17:40 un krita ap četrām jūdzēm no St. Mary’s lidostas. Kompānijas prezidents Džims Hikersons sacīja uz Facebook: 'Hageland strādā, lai savāktu informāciju, lai atbildētu uz jautājumiem un darītu visu, ko varam, lai mazinātu ciešanas tiem, kas iesaistīti avārijā. Kā ģimenes īpašumā esošs uzņēmums, šī ir neaprakstāma trāģēdija mums.' Mirušie: pilots Tērijs Hensons, 68; Ričards Polti, 65; Roza Polti, 57; un Vaiti Kofi, 5 mēneši. Cetri ievainotie joprojām atrodas slimnīcā ar labu stāvokli: Paulīne Džonsona, 37; Šanon Lārens (vecums nav zināms); Tānija Lārens, 35; un Garrets Mūzejs, 30. 14 gadus vecais Kailans Džonsons tika ārstēts un atbrīvots. Melānija Kofi, arī ar labu stāvokli, nepiedalās intervijās. Alaskā iedzīvotāji ir ļoti atkarīgi no gaisa transporta, jo daudzi ciemi nav savienoti ar ceļu tīklu. Pēc CDC datiem, aptuveni 35% no visām ASV komuterlidmašīnu un gaisa taksi avārijām starp 1990. un 2009. gadu notika tieši Alaskā.

article_content: In October 2012, Yoselyn Ortega, a nanny long cherished by the Krim family of Manhattan, allegedly killed six-year-old Lulu and two-year-old Leo Krim before attempting to take her own life. She was found unconscious in the family’s bathroom, having slashed her throat and wrists. The horrific event stunned everyone who knew her — neighbors, friends, and the Krims themselves, who had treated Ortega like family. Ortega had worked for the family for about a year, bonding closely with the children. She often spoke proudly of the generous perks — travel, gifts, and extra hours she willingly worked to help Marina Krim. Her friend Maria Lajara recalled how Ortega once gifted her a leather jacket given to her by Mrs. Krim, a sign of the deep trust and affection shared. But behind the scenes, Ortega’s life was unraveling. She had recently been evicted from her Bronx apartment after the leaseholder returned, forcing her back into her sister’s cramped Harlem home. Friends say she was increasingly withdrawn, exhausted, and anxious. Some noticed she no longer greeted people with her usual ‘God bless you.’ Financial strain weighed heavily on her. Lajara said Ortega once asked her to pray for a woman who owed her money after failing to return cash from selling makeup. Neighbors added she sometimes sold jewelry or cosmetics just to get by. Reports suggest she may have sought psychological help or considered it, as her family told police. The Krims, devastated by the loss, repeatedly emphasized how kind they’d been — paying for Ortega’s trip to visit her family in the Dominican Republic, including them on vacations, and celebrating her as part of their lives. Her own words echoed this: she loved the kids, adored Marina, and felt deeply cared for. Yet none of this explains what led her to commit such an act. Those who knew her say she was gentle, faithful, and devoted — making the tragedy all the more inexplicable. Now, as she lies in a coma, the community searches for answers, grieving not just the children, but the broken life of the woman who took them.
translated_content: Oktobra 2012. gada Jozelīna Ortega, ģimenes pārvadātāja, kuru ilgu laiku cienīja Krimu ģimene Manhetenā, apsūdzama divu bērnu slepkavībā — sešu gadus vecās Lulas un divu gadus vecā Leo Krim — pirms mēģinājuma pašnāvībai. Viņu atrada bezapziņas ģimenes vannasistabā ar izgrieztu rīkli un rokas. Šis bija satraucošs notikums visiem, kas viņu pazīst — kaimiņiem, draugiem un pat Krimiem, kas viņu uzskatīja par ģimenes locekli. Ortega strādāja šai ģimenei aptuveni gadu, veidojot ciešus saikņus ar bērniem. Viņa bieži runāja par dārgvērtīgām priekšrocībām — ceļojumiem, dāvanām un papildu stundām, ko viņa brīvprātīgi darīja, lai palīdzētu Marīnai Krim. Viņas draudzene Marija Lajara atcerējās, ka Ortega vienu reizi dāvināja viņai ādas jaku, ko viņai bija dāvinājusi māsa Krim, kas liecina par dziļu uzticību un mīlestību. Taču aiz fona Ortegas dzīve sabruka. Viņu nesen izdzina no savas apārtmenta Bronksā, kad atgriezās oriģinālais nomnieks, un viņa bija spiesta atgriezties pie sava māsas sašaurinātajā mājā Harlemā. Draugi saka, ka viņa kļuva arvien atkāptāka, nogurusi un uztraukta. Daži piezīmēja, ka viņa vairs neveica savus iepriekšējos sveicienus „Dievs jūs labvēlīgi apsargā.” Finansiālā grūtība smagi slogoja viņu. Lajara teica, ka Ortega vienu reizi lūdza viņu lūgt Dievu, lai sieviete, kas tai bija parādā, atdotu naudu, pēc tam kad tā nebija atdevusi naudu par pārdotu krāsu. Kaimiņi piebilda, ka viņa dažreiz pārdeva dārgakmens vai kosmētiku, lai nopelnītu papildu naudu. Ziņas liecina, ka viņa varēja meklēt psihologa palīdzību vai domāja par to, jo viņas ģimene paziņoja policijai. Krimi, izmisuši no zaudējuma, atkārtoti uzsvēra, cik laipni viņi bija bijuši — finansējuši Ortegas ceļojumu uz Dominikānas Republiku, lai tiktos ar viņas ģimeni, iekļaujot viņu ceļojumos un uzskatīdami viņu par savu ģimenes locekli. Viņas pašas vārdi atbalstīja šo: viņa mīlēja bērnus, adorēja Marinu un jutās dziļi aprūpēta. Tomēr nekas neizskaidro, kas ievadīja viņu šādā darbā. Tie, kas viņu pazīst, saka, ka viņa bija mierīga, ticīga un veltīta — tādējādi padarot šo trēcību vēl nepārprotamāku. Tagad, kad viņa atrodas komā, kopiena meklē atbildes, žēlojot ne tikai bērnus, bet arī sabrukušo dzīvi sievietes, kas tos nolādēja.

article_content: After rumors spread that Aston Villa defender Matthew Lowton had clashed with supporters following the team’s 2-0 loss to Queens Park Rangers, manager Paul Lambert swiftly clarified the situation. He explained that Lowton wasn’t arguing with fans — he was simply waving to his wife, Abi, who was sitting in the stands, telling her to head outside. The moment was captured on camera at the final whistle, showing Lowton gesturing warmly toward her. The defeat marked Villa’s fifth straight loss and extended their goal drought to over 531 minutes. Despite controlling nearly two-thirds of the possession, the team struggled to convert chances, particularly in a baffling miscommunication between Joe Cole and Christian Benteke, who both went for the same header and ended up blocking each other — a microcosm of their frustrating night. Lambert was scathing about the defensive errors that led to both of Charlie Austin’s goals. 'The two goals were really poor,' he said. 'We can’t have that much of the ball and still lose.' He also acknowledged that Benteke, playing only his second match since returning from a six-month injury, is still finding his rhythm. 'He might need six or seven games to get up to speed,' Lambert admitted, adding that signs of improvement are visible. Though frustrated, the Villa boss remained hopeful. 'There are goals in this team,' he insisted, pointing to the returning trio of Benteke, Weimann, and Agbonlahor — along with the experienced Bent — as reasons to believe things will turn around. Their next test? A home clash against Tottenham. Meanwhile, QPR celebrated a vital win. Charlie Austin’s brace lifted them out of the Premier League’s bottom spot, giving manager Harry Redknapp some breathing room. For Villa, the focus now shifts to regrouping behind closed doors — and making sure what happens in the dressing room stays there.

article_content: Maria Cristerna, once feared as 'The Vampire Lady,' has become a beacon of resilience in Guadalajara, Mexico. Once met with crossed streets and superstitious gestures, she now inspires those who once shunned her. At 35, Cristerna’s appearance—covered in tattoos, with custom-fitted fangs and titanium horns embedded beneath her skin—is a bold statement born from survival, not shock value. Growing up in a strict religious household and enduring years of domestic abuse, Cristerna found freedom in self-expression. She transitioned from law to becoming a vibrant video jockey, traveling the globe alongside her DJ partner, Gis Sanchez. Despite her intimidating look, she dedicates time to speaking with women who’ve survived abuse, offering hope rooted in lived experience. Friends recall how locals once crossed the road to avoid her, whispering about possession or madness. Today, many greet her with reverence, kissing her hand as if seeking a blessing. 'I’m not a monster,' she says. 'I’m proof that pain can become purpose.' Her body modifications—inspired by pioneers like Steve Haworth—are not merely aesthetic. Subdermal implants, often made of titanium or biocompatible polymers like PTFE and silicone, require months of healing and carry risks: infection, nerve pressure, and rejection. Initial swelling and bruising are common; full internal recovery takes nearly a year. Proper hygiene, like changing pillowcases every two days, is critical. Cristerna doesn’t seek to frighten—she seeks to transform. 'God lives in my actions, not my appearance,' she insists. Whether on stage in Vienna at the Wildstyle tattoo convention or sharing her story with survivors, she embodies the idea that changing your own life can ripple outward. Her journey reminds us: true power isn't in looking different—it's in refusing to let the world define you.

Augšupceļš no stingras reliģiskas ģimenes un gadiem ilgas ģimenes vardarbības viņai deva brīvību pašizteiksmē. Viņa pārgāja no juridiskās profesijas uz video joki (VJ) karjeru, ceļojot pa pasauli kopā ar sava DJ partnera Gis Sanches. Neskatoties uz savu draudzīgo izskatu, viņa veltīt laiku sarunām ar sievietēm, kas piedzīvojušas līdzīgu pieredzi, piedāvājot cerību, kas balstīta uz pašu pieredzi. Šodien daudzi sveicina viņu ar cieņu, noskūpstot roku kā būtu meklēdami svētību. 'Es neesmu monsters,' viņa saka. 'Es esmu pierādījums, ka sāpes var kļūt par mērķi.' Viņas ķermeņa modificēšana, kas iedvesmota no pionieriem kā Stīvs Havorts, nav tikai estētiska. Zemādas ievietojumi, bieži izgatavoti no titāna vai biokompatībām kā PTFE un silikons, prasa mēnešiem ilgu dziedēšanos un nesaista riskus: infekciju, nervu spiedienu un atgrūšanu. Kristerna nevēlas izraisīt bailēs—viņa vēlas pārveidot. 'Dievs dzīvo manās darbībās, nevis manā ārējā izskatā,' viņa uzstāj. Vai nu uz scenas Vīnē, Wildstyle tatuu konferencē, vai daloties ar savu stāstu ar izdzīvojušām sievietēm, viņa iedvesmo domu, ka pārveidojot savu dzīvi, var izraisīt vilni. Viņas ceļš atgādina: patiesā vara nav tā, ka izskaties citādi—tā ir atteikšanās ļaut pasaulei tevi definēt.

article_content: A passenger on an American Airlines flight from Los Angeles (LAX) to New York (JFK) was removed after repeatedly singing 'I Will Always Love You,' the iconic song popularized by Dolly Parton and Whitney Houston. The flight was diverted to Kansas City International Airport (MCI) on Thursday evening due to disruptive behavior, according to CNN affiliate KMBC. Passenger video footage shows the woman singing as she was escorted off the aircraft by law enforcement. Kansas City International Airport spokesman Tom McKenna confirmed, 'The passenger was detained, not arrested, and then released pending further investigation by the TSA and federal air marshals.' He added, 'I can confirm she was singing 'I Will Always Love You' as she was escorted off the plane.' According to the Kansas City Aviation Department, the woman failed to comply with instructions from a federal air marshal. KMBC reported that she told authorities her actions were linked to her diabetes. American Airlines spokesman Matt Miller stated, 'I can confirm that American Airlines Flight 4 from LAX to JFK diverted to MCI last Thursday evening due to a disruptive passenger.'

Lidojums tika novirzīts uz Kanzasas pilsētas starptautisko lidostu (MCI) ceturtdien vakarā, jo cilvēks izraisīja traucējumus, paziņoja CNN filiāle KMBC. Ceļinieku videoklipā redzams, kā sieviete dzied, kad viņu evakuē no lidmašīnas ar policiju. Kanzasas pilsētas starptautiskās lidostas pārstāvis Toms Makkena apstiprināja: 'Cilvēks tika aizturēts, nevis arestēts, un pēc tam atbrīvots, gaidot turpmāku izmeklēšanu no Pārvadājumu drošības administrācijas (TSA) un federālo gaisa maršalu.' Viņš piebilda: 'Es varu apstiprināt, ka viņa dziedāja 'I Will Always Love You', kad viņu evakuēja no lidmašīnas.' Pēc Kanzasas pilsētas aviacijas departamenta informācijas, sieviete neievēroja federālā gaisa maršala norādījumus. KMBC ziņo, ka viņa paziņoja iestādēm, ka savu uzvedību izraisīja diabēts. ASV aviokompānijas pārstāvis Mets Milers teica: 'Es varu apstiprināt, ka ASV aviokompānijas lidojums 4 no LAX uz JFK tika novirzīts uz MCI ceturtdien vakarā, jo bija traucējošs ceļinieks.'

article_content: Dario Conca, the Argentine playmaker for Fluminense, has been named Brazil’s Player of the Year for the second consecutive season, after leading the Rio-based club to their first domestic title in 26 years. Over the course of the campaign, Conca created 18 goals — the most in the league — and was instrumental in securing Fluminense’s second-ever Brazilian championship. A solitary strike from striker Emerson sealed a 1-0 victory over relegated Guarani on Sunday, clinching the title for manager Muricy Ramalho’s side, who finished top of the standings. Ramalho now boasts four league titles in five seasons, having previously won three with São Paulo between 2006 and 2009. Despite never having represented Argentina internationally, the 27-year-old midfielder expressed deep gratitude toward Fluminense and his ambition to remain with the club for the rest of his career. 'I’m honored to be a fan favorite here,' Conca told FIFA’s official website. 'I’ve received incredible support from the fans, teammates, and coaching staff. I feel truly at home — if I had my way, I’d retire here.' He also revealed his dream of earning a call-up to the Argentine national team. 'Playing for my country would be a tremendous honor. I left Argentina as a child, which complicates things, but I’m still hopeful. I believe Fluminense’s success this year could open doors.'

article_content: The largest stadium in the United States, Michigan Stadium, buzzed with energy as tens of thousands of fans cheered under a dazzling blue glow. Phones held aloft created a constellation of tiny lights across the crowd. On the giant screen, a video roared: 'This is our team! This is Michigan!' — igniting a wave of applause. The spectacle was made possible by a newly installed visual entertainment system, unveiled on September 16, featuring dynamic, synchronized LED lighting that pulses in rhythm with touchdowns and music. The University of Michigan’s iconic maize (a rich golden-yellow) and blue colors inspired the palette. 'It 100% changes the experience inside the stadium,' says Jake Stocker, Director of Game Presentation and Fan Experience. 'It’s one more thrilling element you can’t get watching from your couch.' At the heart of the show are RGB LED luminaires — units that emit red, green, and blue light. By blending these primary colors at varying intensities, the system produces nearly any hue imaginable. 'We’re seeing this demand trickle down even to high schools,' notes Brad Schlesselman, Senior Research Engineer at Musco Lighting, the technology provider. Beyond sports venues, cities across America are adopting LED lighting for landmarks: water towers glow pink during Breast Cancer Awareness Month, for instance — which happens to be October. But this dazzling display owes its existence to a breakthrough from decades ago. Powerful blue LEDs — essential for full-color lighting — were nearly impossible to create until the 1990s. When scientists finally succeeded, they earned the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2014. Blue light’s high energy requires materials like gallium nitride, notoriously hard to manufacture without defects. Today, blue LEDs also serve as the base for white light, using phosphor coatings to shift the hue. Yet innovation continues. Researchers at Stanford are exploring perovskite-based LEDs — cheap, tunable, and potentially paintable as light-emitting films. Though currently unstable, their durability has improved since early tests. Meanwhile, Japanese engineers have engineered a blue LED that runs on just 1.47 volts — half the voltage previously thought necessary — by cleverly boosting photon emission efficiency. Published in September, the breakthrough could lead to ultra-low-power lighting. In parallel, companies like Plessey Semiconductors are pushing micro-LEDs — tiny, sub-20-micron pixels — for next-generation AR and VR headsets. While green and blue micro-LEDs are advancing rapidly, red ones remain stubbornly inefficient due to edge losses at microscopic scales. Despite decades of progress, LED technology is far from finished. As Stanford’s Dan Congreve puts it: 'There’s still room to grow — and glow.'

Šo spektakli iespējams pateicoties jaunai vizuālās izklaides sistēmai, kas tika ieviesta 16. septembrī, un kurā dinamiskās, sinhronizētās LED gaismas pulsē pa ritmu ar tūčiem un mūziku. Mihiganas universitātes ikona — dzeltenā (maize) un zila krāsa — bija inspirācija krāsu palaišanai. 'Tas 100 % maina pieredzi stadionā,' saka Džeks Stokers, Spēļu prezentācijas un skatītāju pieredzes direktors. 'Tas ir vēl viena aizraujoša lieta, ko nevar iegūt, sēdot mājās uz sofa.' Šīs rādījuma sirdī ir RGB LED lumināri — ierīces, kas emitē sarkano, zaļo un zilo gaismu. Izmantojot šīs trīs pamata krāsas dažādos intensitātes līmeņos, sistēma var radīt gandrīz jebkuru krāsu. 'Mēs redzam šo pieprasījumu nonākam pat līdz vidusskolām,' piezīmē Braids Šlesemans, Musco Lighting senior pētniekinženieris, kas nodrošināja tehnoloģiju. Ārpus sporta arenām, ASV pilsētas ievieš LED apgaismojumu arī cietokšņiem: piemēram, ūdens torni kļūst rožaini sieviešu krūts vēža apzināšanas mēnesī — kas ir tieši šis mēnesis, oktobris. Bet šis aizraujošais rādījums ir iespējams pateicoties senām atklājumiem. Spēcīgas zilas LED — kas ir būtiskas pilnai krāsu spektra attēlošanai — bija gandrīz neiespējamas līdz 1990. gadu beigām. Kad zinātnieki beidzot panāca veiksmi, viņi saņēma 2014. gada Fizikas Nobela prēmiju. Zilās gaismas augsta enerģija prasa materiālus kā gallija nitrīdu, kas ir ļoti grūti ražot bez defektiem. Šodien zilas LED tiek izmantotas kā bāze balto gaismu, izmantojot fosfora pārklājumus, lai mainītu krāsu. Tomēr inovācijas turpinās. Pētnieki no Stanforda pēta perovskīta LED — lētus, pielāgojamus un potenciāli pievārāmus kā gaismas emisijas slāni. Lai gan pašlaik tie nav stabilie, to ilgtspēja ir uzlabojusies kopš pirmajiem eksperimentiem. Starp citu, japāņu inženieri izstrādāja zilo LED, kas darbojas tikai ar 1,47 voltiem — puse no iepriekšēji domātās vajadzīgās sprieguma vērtības — izmantojot gudru fotoniem radīšanu. Septembrī publicētais atklājums var novest pie ekstremāli zema patēriņa apgaismojuma. Paralēli, uzņēmumi kā Plessey Semiconductors attīsta mikro-LED — milzīgi mazus, mazākus par 20 mikroniem, pikseļus — nākamās paaudzes AR un VR galvas kārpiem. Lai gan zaļās un zilās mikro-LED attīstās ātri, sarkanās joprojām ir neefektīvas, jo mikroskopiskajā mērogā tās malas izraisa pārmērīgu zudumu. Neskatoties uz desmitgadēju progresu, LED tehnoloģija ir tālu no beigām. Kā Stanforda Džens Konkrivs saka: 'Vēl ir vietas, kur attīstīties — un spīdēt.'

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) — Open any fashion magazine, and you’re immediately surrounded by dazzling celebrities adorned in glittering jewels and effortlessly styled 'messy hair.' They glide in towering stilettos, showcasing sculpted figures in garments that cost as much as a mortgage. Close the magazine—or better yet, toss it aside—and you might feel a pang of inadequacy. Why should beauty and style be reserved for those who can afford it? But for over three decades, one garment has quietly bridged that divide: the DVF wrap dress. Like the timeless Little Black Dress, it’s become a wardrobe essential for countless women. Diane von Furstenberg introduced her signature wrap dress in the 1970s. 'What made it different,' the Belgian designer told CNN, 'was that I used jersey—it hugged the body naturally and flattered every shape.' Technically, it’s akin to a kimono: no buttons, no zippers, just elegant draping. Millions have sold since its debut. Yet, like all trends, it faced decline. 'Fashion changed,' von Furstenberg recalls. 'Then, about ten years ago, I noticed young women buying them in thrift stores. That’s when I knew it was coming back.' Today, DVF wrap dresses are sold in boutiques—but equally cherished in vintage shops and on platforms like eBay. Anna Boccia Lewis, a self-proclaimed 'DVF addict' from California, remembers buying her first piece—a yellow floral shirtdress—for just $4.75 at Goodwill. 'Each DVF design has its own personality,' she says, 'just like the woman wearing it.' Carolyn Yapp, 24, from Jamaica, says it makes her feel 'sexy, successful, sophisticated, and timeless.' Melissa Calivis Green of Baltimore sees the bold prints as symbols of 'powerful femininity and endless possibility.' Tracey Jennings from the UK owns wrap dresses in sizes 4 to 10, adapting as her body changed. Kirsty Palmer, also in the UK, sells hers on eBay to refresh her collection: 'Vintage gives me the same quality and elegance—at a fraction of the price.' Do you own a DVF wrap dress? translated_content: LONDONS, Anglijā (CNN) — Atveriet jebkuru mode žurnālu, un jūs tieši ap apkārt esat apspīdēti ar dārgām, radīgām zvaigznēm, kas ir apsedzas ar spīdīgiem akmeņiem un ideāli izkārtotu 'nepakārtu matu.' Tās staigā pa augstām kājām, parādot veidotos figūras apģērbā, kas var maksāt tik daudz, cik hipotēka. Aizveriet šo pašu mode žurnālu — vai, labāk, mazliet mīlīgi metiet to sienā — un jūs varat justies nedaudz nepilnvērtīgi un aizskārīgi. Kad gan mums vajadzētu būt ārpus visām šīm prieka izjūtām, tikai tāpēc, ka mēs nevaram atļauties apģērbus žurnālā? Bet viens apģērbs ir līdz pat trimdesmit gadiem savienojis šo atstarpi starp bagātajiem un vidējo sievieti. Šis apģērbs ir Dianes fon Furstembergas avīzes kleita. Tāpat kā 'Mazā Melnā Kleita,' Furstembergas avīzes kleita ir uzskatīta par būtisku daudzu sieviešu apģērbu. Dianes fon Furstemberga, vai DVF, kā viņu sauc, pārdeva savu pirmo avīzes kleitu 1970. gados. 'Tas bija unikāls fenomens,' beļģu dizainers teica CNN. 'To, kas bija jauns manā avīzes kleitā, bija tas, ka es to izgatavoju no jakera, un tā tāpēc piegāja ķermenim un bija ļoti izdevīga ķermeņam.' Teņiski runājot, avīzes kleita ir kā kimono: bez pogām un auklēm, vienkārši eleganti krītoša. Miljoni tika pārdoti kopš tās izveidošanas. Tomēr, kā jebkurš trends, tā piedzīvoja nolaiduma periodus. 'Mode pilnībā mainījās, un lietas pazuda,' teica fon Furstemberga. 'Pirms desmit gadiem es sāku atkal, jo redzēju, ka ļoti modernas jaunas meitenes tās iegādājas antikvariātos.' Šis trends turpinās līdz šodienai. Lai gan kleitas ir pieejamas DVF veikalos, tās tiek regulāri iegādātas un pārdotas antikvariātos un caur tiešsaistes aukcijām, piemēram, eBay. 'Manas mīlestības ar DVF avīzes kleitu sākums bija 1970. gados,' saka Anna Boccia Lewis, kaliforniešu 'DVF alkāpniece.' 'Viens no maniem pirmajiem iegādājumiem bija dzeltens puķains vintāžas DVF širtkleita, ko es atradu Goodwill South San Franciscā par 4,75 dolāriem.' 'Es domāju, ka viss, ko es mīlu DVF dizainos, ir tas, ka katrs no tiem ir ar savu specifisko personību — tieši kā sieviete, kas to valkā,' teica Anna. CNN jautāja citām sievietēm, kāpēc DVF kleitas ir tik īpašas. Pasakiet mums savu stāstu — 'Sakiet savu viedokli' zemāk. 'Tās padara mani ne tikai seksi, bet arī veiksmīgu, sofistisku un laikapstākļu neietekmējamu,' saka 24 gadus vecā DVF entuziaste Karolīna Japa no Jamaikas. Melisa Kalivisa Grīna no Baltimoras teica mums: 'Man avīzes raksti simbolizē spēcīgu sievišķību un nebeidzamu iespēju apsolījumu.' Apvienotās Karalistes Tracey Jennings vada DVF kleitas jau desmit gadus. Viņa teica: 'Kā daudzām sievietēm, manā ķermenī bija mainījies izmērs no gada uz gadu. Tāpēc manas avīzes kleitas svārstās no četrpadsmit līdz desmitajam izmēram.' Arī Apvienotās Karalistes Kīrstija Palmere pirms nedēļas pārdeva vienu no savām DVF kleitām eBay. 'Es gribu mainīt savu izvēli,' viņa sacīja. 'Vintāžas avīzes kleitas iegāde padara tās pieejamākas man, taču es joprojām iegūstu tādu pašu labumu kā, ja es iegādājos jaunu, tāpēc ka tām ir klasiskas griezumus un ilgtspējīgums.' Vai jums ir DVF avīzes kleita? Ja jā, mēs vēlamies dzirdēt no jums. Kāpēc jūs to iegādājāties un ko tā jums nozīmē? 'Sakiet savu viedokli' zemāk vai nosūtiet mums e-pastu ar attēlu vai dodieties uz CNN Facebook lapu — facebook.com/cnnintl.

article_content: Hollywood is grappling with one of its toughest summers in years as several heavily funded blockbusters have struggled to attract audiences. Despite star power and massive budgets, films like Disney’s $225 million 'The Lone Ranger'—featuring Johnny Depp and Armie Hammer—earned just $29 million during its July 4 debut. Sony’s 'White House Down', with a $150 million price tag, opened even lower at $25 million. Meanwhile, Guillermo del Toro’s ambitious sci-fi epic 'Pacific Rim', costing $180 million, is forecasted to land around $30 million in its first weekend. Other underperformers include 'R.I.P.D.', a $130 million action thriller with Jeff Bridges and Ryan Reynolds, expected to gross under $15 million, and DreamWorks’ animated family film 'Turbo', a $135 million project about a racing snail, projected to barely break $30 million. This slump contrasts sharply with the $168 million opening of 'The Dark Knight Rises' back in July 2012. Still, there are flickers of hope: Sony’s 'Grown Ups 2', starring Adam Sandler and backed by an $80 million budget, is anticipated to earn between $40 and $45 million. Fox’s 'Wolverine', led by Hugh Jackman, is projected to draw a strong $70 million when it hits theaters later in July. Industry insiders are hoping this rough patch is temporary—a brief dip between the record-breaking successes of 'Man of Steel' and 'Monsters University' earlier in the summer. August promises a rebound, with new releases including 'Two Guns', 'The Smurfs 2', 'Elysium', 'We’re the Millers', 'Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters', and 'Planes' all vying for attention.

article_content: Last week, watching from the observers’ gallery, I saw Malaysian opposition leader Anwar Ibrahim shift from hope to exasperation—and finally to anger—as the country’s highest court dismissed his defense team’s arguments against his sodomy conviction. After his appeal was denied on all counts, the sentencing hearing began. Anwar then removed all restraint, calling the case a 'complete fabrication' and a 'political conspiracy,' and accusing the five Federal Court judges of becoming 'partners in the crime' against judicial independence and integrity. The judges, unmoved, stood up and left the courtroom to deliberate, leaving behind a stunned audience. Anwar now faces five years in prison—a sentence that raises urgent questions among Malaysians: How can a government prosecute a former deputy prime minister and opposition leader twice under an archaic British colonial law against sodomy, a statute invoked only seven times since 1938? Has Malaysia’s leadership lost all sense of legitimacy, making even outside observers recognize this trial as blatantly political from the start? Within minutes of the verdict, the government released a polished statement asserting Malaysia’s 'judicial independence' and urging all parties to 'respect the legal process.' Yet, simultaneously, a growing crackdown on dissent is unfolding, led by the country’s top police official, who monitors Twitter like a shark patrolling open waters—issuing direct orders to arrest lawyers, activists, and politicians under the draconian Sedition Act. Cartoonist Zunar has already been taken to court for a tweet referencing 'lackeys in black robes.' Malaysia is slated for a pivotal year: chairing ASEAN as the ASEAN Economic Community launches and holding a seat on the UN Security Council. It is also a key partner in the U.S.-backed Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP), and Prime Minister Najib Razak was personally invited by President Obama for a round of golf in Hawaii during the Christmas holidays. Whether Anwar’s case was raised remains unknown. Yet a stark disconnect persists between Malaysia’s international persona as a moderate Muslim-majority democracy and its domestic repression of dissent—a reality rarely acknowledged, except when figures like Anwar, widely respected globally, are imprisoned. Since the 2013 elections, when Najib’s Barisan Nasional coalition lost the popular vote but retained power through gerrymandering, the government has weaponized the Sedition Act’s vague language—banning 'any seditious words' or 'tendency' that might 'bring into hatred or contempt' any ruler or government. In the past two years, over a dozen senior politicians and activists have been prosecuted for speech deemed offensive by authorities, with some fleeing abroad for asylum. At the 2014 UMNO congress, Najib pledged to strengthen the Sedition Act further when Parliament reconvenes in March. Peaceful assemblies are restricted, media freedoms curtailed, books and films censored, and ethnic and religious minorities increasingly targeted. Shaffee Abdullah, the UMNO lawyer appointed as special prosecutor in Anwar’s case, also represents Malaysia on the ASEAN Intergovernmental Commission on Human Rights (AICHR)—and has actively blocked discussions on LGBT rights within the body. Malaysia is cultivating a dangerous blend of authoritarianism and intolerance that should alarm capitals from Washington to Brussels. Anwar’s conviction may mark a new low in Malaysia’s human rights record—but it must be understood not in isolation, but as part of a broader, escalating assault on civil and political liberties emanating from Putrajaya. The international community—including Malaysia’s allies, foreign investors, and the United Nations—must awaken to the reality: Malaysia is changing, and not for the better. Supporting human rights defenders and demanding accountability is no longer optional—it is essential if the world hopes to see a truly democratic, rights-respecting Malaysia.

Pēc tam, kad viņa apelācija tika noraidīta visos punktos, sākās sodu izlikšanas klausīšanās. Anvars tad nolika rokas, saucot šo gadījumu par 'pilnīgu izdomājumu' un 'politisku konspirāciju', un apsūdzot piecus Federālās tiesas tiesnešus, ka viņi kļuvuši par 'noziedznieku biedriem' pret judiciālo neatkarību un integritāti. Tiesneši nevēlējās to dzirdēt un pēkšņi pacēlās un aizgāja no tiesas zāles, lai apsvērtu Anvara likteni, atstājot apbrīnojamu tiesas zāli aiz sevis. Anvaram tagad ir jāpavadī pieci gadi cietumā, lai domātu par jautājumu, kas ir daudzu malaiziešu prātā: kā valdībai izdevās notvert bijušo vicepremjeru un opozīcijas vadītāju divas reizes, izmantojot senu britu kolonialisma likumu par sodomiju, ko kopš 1938. gada piemēroja tikai septiņas reizes? Vai Malaizijas valdība ir zaudējusi visu sapratni par legitimātību, lai pat ārējie novērotāji atzītu šo procesu par skaidri politisku no pirmās dienas? Minūtes pēc sprieduma izsniegšanas valdība izdeva izglītotu paziņojumu, kurā apgalvoja Malaizijas 'judiciālo neatkarību' un aicināja visas iesaistītās puses 'cienīt juridisko procesu un spriedumu'. Tomēr vienlaikus notiek pieaugošs uzspiešanas kampaņas uzspiešana pret nesaskaņu, ko vadīja valsts augstākais policijas amatiņš, kas uzrauga Twitter kā zivs jūrā — izsniedzot tiešus pavēles policijai arestēt advokātus, aktīvistus un politiķus, izmantojot Malaizijas draudzīgo Sēdīcijas likumu. Kartonaista Zunar jau tika aizvests tiesā par twittera ziņojumu, kas atsaucās uz 'melnieem kājām'. Malaizija gaida nozīmīgu gadu: tā ir ASEAN priekšsēdētāja, kad ASEAN ekonomiskā kopiena kļūs par realitāti, un tā ieņem vienu sēdvietu Apvienoto Nāciju Drošības padomē. Tā ir arī būtisks ASV vadītās Transpacifiskās partnerības (TPP) tirdzniecības priekšlikuma dalībniece, un premjerministrs Najibs Razaks bija personīgi uzaicināts prezidenta Obamas aicinājumā spēlēt golfa Havajā, lai pasvītrotu prezidenta Ziemassvētku atvaļinājumu. Vai Anvara lieta tika minēta uz kaila lauka — vēl nav zināms. Tomēr pastāv liela starpība starp Malaizijas starptautisko imidžu kā mērenu musulmaņu vairāku valsti un tās iekšējo represiju pret protestiem — realitāte, kas reti tiek atzīta, izņemot gadījumus, kad Malaizija ieslodzīt cilvēkus kā Anvaru, kurš ir plaši cienīts starptautiski. Kopš 2013. gada vēlēšanām, kad valdošā Barisānas Nacionālā koalīcija zaudēja populāro balsojumu pret Anvara vadīto Pakatan Rakyat koalīciju, bet saglabāja varu, izmantojot gerrymandering, valdība ir izmantojusi Sēdīcijas likumu kā kausu, izmantojot tās neskaidros terminus, kas aizlieg 'jebkuras sēdīciskas vārdus' vai 'sēdīcisku tendenci', kas 'izraisītu naidu vai pagurumu pret jebkuru valdību'. Pēdējos divos gados vairāk nekā ducis augstu politiķu un aktīvistu ir aizvesti tiesā par runām vai tweetiem, kas valdībai nepatika, un daži ir bēguši uz ārzemēm, lai meklētu aizsardzību — un šis saraksts turpinās pieaugt. Najibs apstiprināja 2014. gada UMNO kongresā, ka viņš plāno stiprināt Sēdīcijas likumu vēl vairāk, kad parlaments atsāks darbu martā. Kārtīgas kustības tiek ierobežotas, mediji tiek cenzēti, grāmatas un filmas tiek aizliegtas, un etniskās un reliģiskās minoritātes tiek mērķtiecīgi uzbruktas. Šafījs Abdullāhs, tas pats UMNO advokāts, kas tika iecelts kā īpašs prokurors Anvara lietā, vienlaikus ir Malaizijas pārstāvis reģionālajā cilvēktiesību ķermenī — ASEAN starpvaldību cilvēktiesību komisijā (AICHR) — un apgalvo, ka viņš ir novērsis jebkādas diskusijas par LGBTTQ+ tiesībām. Malaizija audzē bīstamu jaukumu no autoritārismas un netolerancēm, kas būtu jāuztraucas galvaspilsētās kā Vašingtona, Londona, Berlīne un Briselē. Anvara apsūdzība pagājušajā nedēļā var būt jauns zemākais punkts Malaizijas cilvēktiesību rekordā, bet to nevajadzētu redzēt izolēti, bet kā daļu no plašāka, pieaugoša uzbrukuma civiltiesībām un politiskajām brīvībām, kas nāk no Putrajayas. Starptautiskā sabiedrība — gan Malaizijas savienotāji, ārvalstu investori, gan Apvienotās Nācijas — ir jāsāk atzinīgi atzīt, ka Malaizijas valdība mainās, un ne labākā virzienā. Ir laiks atbalstīt Malaizijas cilvēktiesību aizstāvus un atzīt, ka, ja pasaule vēlas demokrātisku, cilvēktiesības cienījošu Malaiziju, tai būs jācīnās par to.

article_content: Kanye West has called off his highly anticipated 'Fame Kills' concert tour with Lady Gaga, just two weeks after it was first unveiled. The decision comes amid growing public attention surrounding his disruptive behavior at the MTV Video Music Awards last month, where he interrupted Taylor Swift’s acceptance speech. Though no official reason was given by promoter Live Nation, West had previously hinted on Jay Leno’s show that he intended to step back from the spotlight to process personal loss — specifically, the unresolved grief over his mother’s death two years prior. Originally scheduled to launch next month with 34 shows across the U.S. and Canada, the tour had already begun selling tickets. Fans who bought tickets can expect full refunds, either through their original point of purchase or automatically if ordered online or by phone. In his emotional interview with Leno, West reflected on the relentless pace of fame, saying he’d never allowed himself space to heal, caught in a cycle of music and touring. The incident sparked widespread debate, but West’s apology and candid remarks have prompted some to view his actions less as recklessness and more as a cry for emotional respite.
