article_content: In August 2013, Frank Worsley, a 90-year-old World War II veteran and longtime resident of Bolton, was attacked in his own home by 24-year-old Daniel Crompton, who broke in seeking money. Worsley, who had been living alone since his wife Mary passed away in 2012, was asleep when Crompton entered through an open bathroom window. Startled awake, Worsley was punched repeatedly in the face as Crompton screamed for cash. Despite Worsley’s pleas that he had no money, Crompton wrapped his hand in a shirt and continued the assault, leaving Worsley with facial injuries and a severe brain bleed. After stealing a wallet and chequebook, Crompton fled — leaving behind a palmprint on the window frame. Worsley called 999, trembling and breathless, begging for help. He was rushed to Royal Bolton Hospital, where doctors stopped his blood-thinning medication, Warfarin, to prevent further internal bleeding. But the trauma triggered a stroke. He died 17 days later. Crompton, who admitted to two burglaries that night — including one at a friend’s home — claims he never intended to kill. Prosecutors argue his violent escalation, fueled by cocaine dependency and financial strain, constitutes murder. The case has drawn widespread shock, particularly after the emotional 999 recording was played in court.
translated_content: 2013. gada augustā 90 gadus vecais Otrā pasaules kara veterāns Frenks Vorsli tika uzbrukts savā mājā Boltonā ar 24 gadus veco Dānijelu Kromptonu, kas ielauzās, lai meklētu naudu. Vorsli, kurš dzīvoja viens pēc sievas Mārijas nāves 2012. gadā, bija miegā, kad Kromptons iekļuva caur atvērtu vannasistabas logu. Pobudināts, Vorsli tika daudzkārt sitis sejā, kamēr Kromptons raudāja par naudu. Neskatoties uz Vorsli lūgumiem, ka viņam nav naudas, Kromptons apvārca roku ar kreklu un turpināja uzbrukumu, atstājot Vorsli ar sejas traumām un smadzeņu asiņošanu. Pēc naudas un čekgrāmatas nozagšanas Kromptons aizbēga, atstājot plakanspiedenu uz loga rāmja. Vorsli izsaucās 999, drebošs un elpojot grūti, lūdzot palīdzību. Viņu steidzami nogādāja Royal Bolton slimnīcā, kur ārsti apturēja viņa asinsšķidrinātāju — varfarīnu — lai novērstu papildu asiņošanu. Tomēr traumas izraisīja insultu. Viņš mira 17 dienas vēlāk. Kromptons, kurš atzina divas nozagšanas šajā naktī — ieskaitot drauga māju — apgalvo, ka nekad nebija domājis nogalināt. Prokurori argumentē, ka viņa vardarbiskā uzvedība, izraisīta kokainu atkarības un finansiālas grūtības, ir slepkavība. Lieta ir izraisījusi plašu satricinājumu, īpaši pēc emocionālās 999 ieraksta atskaņošanas tiesā.
post_content: Heartbreaking. A 90-year-old WWII vet was beaten in his sleep, then died 17 days later after being robbed. The suspect stole his wallet… but left a fingerprint. This isn’t just burglary — it’s cruelty. #JusticeForFrank #ElderAbuse #EndDrugViolence

article_content: Tucked away in the remote waters of El Nido, Philippines, lies Maosonon Island — a secluded tropical haven now listed for £2.9 million. Locally known as Maosonon but dubbed 'Mystery Island' due to its unexplored nature, this 112-acre parcel offers untouched beauty: powdery white sands, crystal-clear turquoise seas, and thriving coral reefs perfect for diving. The island consists of a main triangular landmass and a smaller neighboring islet, both completely undeveloped with no buildings, roads, or residents. Once owned by a prominent Palawan political family and later acquired by resort developers from Boracay, plans to build never materialized. Today, it remains a blank canvas for a private buyer seeking ultimate seclusion. The area falls within a protected ecological zone, home to diverse plant and animal life, with climate and marine conditions similar to nearby islands. Because no formal environmental or archaeological studies have ever been conducted here, the island retains its enigmatic reputation. Potential owners can enjoy private natural harbors, gentle rolling hills, hidden rock pools, and dense elevated forests. Access is solely by boat, though it’s within reasonable reach of Manila and other El Nido islands. The future of Maosonon is entirely up to the new owner — whether they envision a private retreat or a sustainable eco-resort, the choice remains theirs.
translated_content: Slēptā El Nido, Filipīnās, atrodas Maosonona sala — izolēts tropiskais paradīzes punkts, kas tiek piedāvāts par 2,9 miljoniem sterlingu. Vietēji zināma kā Maosonona, bet dēvēta par 'Mistērijas salu' tās neizpētītā dabas dēļ. Šī 112 akru teritorija piedāvā neaizskartu skaistumu: baltas smilšu pludmales, kristāliski zilas jūras ūdeņus un dzīvotāju koraļļu rifu, ideālu peldēšanai. Sala sastāv no galvenā trijstūrveida masīva un mazākas blakus esošas saliņas, abas pilnībā neattīstītas, bez ēkām, ceļiem vai iedzīvotājiem. Iepriekš tā piederēja ietekmīgai Palavanas politiķu ģimenei, vēlāk tā tika iegādāta resortu īpašniekiem no Boracaya, taču attīstības plāni nekad netika īstenoti. Šobrīd tā paliek tukša lappuse privātam pircējam, kas meklē absolūtu izolāciju. article_content: By Helen Collis. PUBLISHED: 03:12 EST, 12 August 2013. | UPDATED: 07:05 EST, 12 August 2013. An adorable Rottweiler puppy was rescued from a hot vehicle by a passerby — and immediately adopted on the spot by former Dallas Cowboys coach Barry Switzer. Switzer noticed the small puppy while walking into a store and saw it was leashed in the back of a van on a sweltering day. Though the windows were open, he described the temperature inside as 'awful hot.' Moved by the puppy’s appearance and vulnerability, Switzer waited for the owners to return, then purchased the dog there and then. He named her Sassy. A lifelong animal lover, Switzer took the puppy directly to the vet for a full examination, including rabies and worm vaccinations, and even had her nails trimmed. The big-eyed pup quickly became a favorite in Switzer’s home, delighting his German Shepherd, Sieger, with playful antics. Switzer, who already owns several dogs, decided he couldn’t keep Sassy. He renamed her Stella and began searching for a loving, permanent home. He found the perfect match: an Oklahoma couple who lost their home in the devastating Moore tornado earlier that year. The arrival of Stella coincides with their wedding anniversary. Switzer hopes Stella will bring joy and healing to the couple during their recovery.

article_content: After helping France reach the Round of 16 at the 2014 World Cup, Bacary Sagna unwound on a sunny Rio beach with his wife, Ludivine, and their kids — a rare moment of calm before his next chapter. Though he’d just sealed a free transfer to Manchester City, his departure from Arsenal wasn’t driven by cash, he insists. For seven straight years, Sagna played on the same contract at the Emirates, turning down multiple extensions without ever asking for a raise. 'People keep saying I'm greedy,' he said. 'That’s not true. I just needed a new challenge.' The right-back, whose final appearance for Arsenal came in their emotional 3-2 FA Cup final win over Hull City, called the trophy his proudest achievement with the club — but stressed it wasn’t the reason he left. 'Arsenal made me who I am today,' he added. 'But I felt it was time for a fresh start, somewhere with a real shot at the Premier League and Champions League.' Despite the distractions of cup finals and mounting rumors, Sagna remained focused on his duties, asking his family to ignore the noise. Now, as a confirmed City player, he’s eager to build something new under Manuel Pellegrini — and ready to leave behind the speculation that followed him out of North London.

Septiņus gadus Sagnas spēlēja uz tā paša līguma, noraidot vairākus pagarinājuma piedāvājumus, nekad neprasa augstāku algu. 'Cilvēki saka, ka esmu ļauns,' viņš teica. 'Tas nav patiess. article_content: Katie Couric revealed last night on Jimmy Kimmel Live! that she had to rebuff unwanted advances from television legend Larry King after a date roughly 25 years ago. The two went to dinner at an Italian restaurant in Washington, D.C., and afterward, King drove Couric back to his apartment in Roslyn, Virginia — where he attempted to initiate physical intimacy. Couric, then 31, said she was navigating a phase in her life where she said yes to anyone who asked her out, believing she'd learn something from every experience. She recalled King arriving in a Lincoln Town Car and ordering veal poached in chicken stock — a choice she joked about given his recent quadruple bypass surgery. Once at his apartment, Couric was startled to find it filled with proclamations declaring 'Larry King Day' and keys to cities across the U.S. 'That was sexy!' she sarcastically remarked. When King moved toward her, she laughed nervously and gently turned him down: 'Larry, you're such an interesting, nice man, but I’d like to meet someone a little closer to my age.' He replied, 'That’s okay — when I like, I really like.' Couric managed to leave without further incident. She said the moment felt like something out of a bad Lifetime movie. King, now 79, has a different memory of the evening. In a 2009 interview, he claimed they shared a polite goodnight kiss at her door, and that she mentioned having a roommate — after which they remained friends. Couric also shared another odd anecdote: Michael Jackson once asked her on a date after she declined to grant him an interview. She declined, fearing the media backlash and how it would sound to her young daughters.

article_content: A co-pilot aboard Ethiopian Airlines Flight 702, Hailemedehin Abera Tagegn, took control of the Boeing 767 mid-flight, diverting it from its route to Rome toward Geneva. He reportedly feared for his life in Ethiopia and sought asylum. The aircraft issued a standard hijack code—7500—over Sudan, alerting aviation authorities. As the plane entered Swiss airspace, Swiss military officials were notified at 4:30 a.m., but they could not respond because their airbase operates only between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. Due to this restriction, Italy and France scrambled fighter jets to guide the plane safely into Geneva Airport, where it landed with only 20 minutes of fuel left. After touchdown, Abera descended from the cockpit using a rope and immediately surrendered to police, stating he wanted protection from persecution in his home country. Passengers, unaware of the hijacking until after landing, described a tense but non-violent ordeal: crew members circulated quietly, offering drinks and reassurance, though some were seen crying. Geneva’s airport was briefly shut down, but operations resumed within two hours. Swiss authorities confirmed they were legally and logistically unable to act overnight, citing limited personnel and funding. The 31-year-old co-pilot had no criminal history and was assessed as mentally competent. Meanwhile, Ethiopian Airlines has faced multiple hijackings since the 1990s, and Ethiopia continues to draw international criticism for suppressing dissent, restricting free speech, and targeting minority communities. Geneva prosecutors are now preparing charges that could lead to up to 20 years in prison.

Viņš paziņoja, ka bailēs no savas dzimtās valsts un meklē azilu. Lidmašīna izsūtīja standarta nolaupīšanas kodu — 7500 — pāri Sudānai, brīdinot aviācijas iestādes. Kad lidmašīna iegāja Šveices gaisa telpā, Šveices karaspēks tika informēts plkst. 4:30, bet viņi nevarēja reaģēt, jo to bāze strādā tikai no 8:00 līdz 17:00. Šī ierobežojuma dēļ Itālija un Francija izlaida cīnītājlidmašīnas, lai novadītu lidmašīnu droši uz Ženēvas lidostu, kur tā nolaidās ar tikai 20 minūtēm degvielas paliktni. Pēc nolaišanās Abera nolāpījās no kabineta ar motora kāpu un tieši nododās policijai, teikdams, ka vēlas aizsardzību no persekucijas savā dzimtajā valstī. Lietotāji, kas nebija apzinājušies nolaupīšanu līdz nolaišanās momentam, aprakstīja saspringtu, bet nevarīgu piedzīvojumu: apkalpe klusi apgādāja ar dzērieniem un atbalstu, taču daži bija redzami raudājoši. Ženēvas lidosta tika īslaicīgi slēgta, bet darbības tika atjaunotas divu stundu laikā. Šveices iestādes apstiprināja, ka tās juridiski un loģistiski nevarēja reaģēt naktī, citējot ierobežotus personālu un finanses. 31 gadu vecais ko-pilots nebijās kriminālās zīmes un tika novērtēts kā garīgi kompetents. Tālāk, Etiopijas lidlaivu kompānijai ir bijušas vairākas nolaupīšanas kopš 1990. gadiem, un Etiopija turpinās saņemt starptautisku kritiku par protestu slēgšanu, brīvības izteiksmes ierobežošanu un minoritāšu mērķtiecīgu uzbrukumu. Ženēvas prokuratūra gatavojas iesniegt apsūdzības, kas varētu novedīt pie līdz 20 gadiem ieslodzījuma.

article_content: Thousands of veterans who braved the brutal Arctic convoys during World War II to deliver vital supplies to the Soviet Union have been told they cannot accept Russia’s Ushakov Medal for bravery — despite being honored by the Russian government for their extraordinary courage. These sailors endured freezing temperatures, relentless enemy attacks, and perilous sea conditions. Many ships, like HMS Edinburgh, were struck by torpedoes and sunk. The Edinburgh, carrying four tonnes of gold bullion as payment from Stalin, was attacked over successive days by aircraft, submarines, and destroyers before sinking in April 1942. Two officers and 56 seamen lost their lives. Among those aboard was 90-year-old Lieutenant Commander Roy Francis, who recalls the unrelenting cold: 'We had to keep chipping away at the ice. We were constantly wet, and it was usually too cold to sleep.' The UK’s Foreign and Commonwealth Office (FCO) has refused permission for veterans to accept the Russian medal, citing a rule that prohibits acceptance of foreign honors if the recipient has already received a British campaign medal — in this case, the Atlantic Star. Veterans argue the Ushakov Medal is not a campaign medal but a personal award for bravery, making the restriction unfair. They point out that Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and the United States all permit their veterans to accept it. In response to growing pressure, the UK government has announced plans to create a new Arctic Campaign Medal to formally recognize these veterans. However, the process is slow, and many fear they won’t live to see it. Francis says: 'I think they’ve got it wrong. Why can’t the UK bend the rules when our allies have shown such respect?' The FCO maintains its position, stating that foreign awards require either recent service (within five years) or no prior UK recognition for the same actions. A lapel badge, the Arctic Emblem, was issued in 2006 to over 10,000 veterans — but many say it’s not enough. An e-petition calling for policy reform now sits on the Downing Street website, urging the government to do right by those who sacrificed everything for freedom.

Šie jūrnieki izturēja ledus sasaldējošās temperatūras, neatlaidīgas ienaidnieka uzbrukumus un bīstamas jūras apstākļus. Daudzi kuģi, piemēram, HMS Edinburgh, tika apstrādāti ar torpēdām un noslēgti. Edinburgh, kas pārvadāja četrus tonnas zelta bullionu kā maksājumu no Stalina, tika uzbrukta vairākas dienas ilgi ar lidmašīnām, zemūdenēm un kuģiem, pirms tā tika noslēgta 1942. gada aprīlī. Divi virsnieki un 56 jūrnieki zaudēja dzīvību. Viens no tiem, kas bija uz kuģa, bija 90 gadus vecais leitnants-komandieris Rojs Frānsiss, kurš atceras nepārtraukto aukstumu: „Mums bija jālāpsta ledus. Mēs bijām pastāvīgi mitri, un parasti bija pārāk auksti, lai aizmigtu.“ Apvienotās Karalistes Ārlietu un Īpašo valstu birojs (FCO) ir atteikušies atļaut jūrniekiem pieņemt Krievijas medaļu, citējot noteikumu, kas aizliegts pieņemt svešvalsts godu, ja saņēmējs jau ir saņēmis britu kampaņas medaļu — šajā gadījumā Atlantijas Zvaigzni. Cīnītāji argumentē, ka Ušakovas medaļa nav kampaņas medaļa, bet personisks godojums par drosmi, tādēļ ierobežojums ir nežēlīgs. Viņi norāda, ka Austrālija, Kanāda, Jaunzēlande un ASV visi atļauj saviem cīnītājiem pieņemt to. Reakcijā uz pieaugošu spiedienu Lielbritānijas valdība ir paziņojusi plānus izveidot jaunu Arktikas kampaņas medaļu, lai oficiāli atzītu šos cīnītājus. Tomēr process ir lēns, un daudzi bažījas, ka neizdzīvos līdz tam. Frānsiss saka: „Es domāju, ka viņi ir kļūdījušies. Kāpēc Lielbritānija nevar izmainīt noteikumus, kad mūsu sabiedrotie ir parādījuši tik lielu cieņu?“ FCO saglabā savu pozīciju, norādot, ka svešvalsts godi prasa vai nu nesenām dienestam (pieciem gadiem), vai arī neesamību iepriekšējam britu atzīšanai par tām pašām darbībām. Lapeļa žetons — Arktikas emblēma — tika izdots 2006. gadā vairāk nekā 10 000 jūrniekiem, taču daudzi saka, ka tas nav pietiekami. E-petičija, kas aicina pārskatīt politiku, tagad atrodas Douningas ielas vietnē, aicinot valdību darīt pareizi tiem, kas visu bija upurējuši brīvībai.

article_content: Brace for bad news ahead of winter: Natural gas prices could spike as energy giant Chevron halted operations at a major Israeli gas field following orders from authorities. 'In the wake of the situation, Israel's defense establishment ordered the temporary suspension of natural gas supplies from the Tamar field,' Israel's Energy Ministry said on Monday. The Tamar offshore gas platform—off Israel's southern coast—is within range of rocket fire from the Israel-Hamas war. The shutdown could be a dire development for global energy markets. Energy markets have already been rocked by the war in Ukraine and threats of a strike in Australia, another major gas producer. While Israel isn't a top natural gas producer, its output has grown significantly since production began at several fields, including Tamar. Chevron owns a 25% stake in Tamar, while Houston-based Isramco holds 28.75%. Some Israeli gas from Tamar is exported to Egypt, a key player in the European Union's energy security. That's because Egypt processes the fuel into liquefied natural gas (LNG), which is then exported to EU countries seeking to reduce dependence on Russian energy amid the war in Ukraine. It's not immediately clear how much LNG Egypt has been shipping to Europe, but investors have already been spooked by Tamar's shutdown, as evidenced by a surge in natural gas futures prices. After news of the shutdown circulated, benchmark Dutch gas futures surged nearly 30% this week, reaching 49.455 euros per megawatt-hour on Tuesday—the highest level since August. As natural gas is primarily used for electricity generation and heating, higher prices could lead to increased power bills for consumers. Chevron told Insider it will continue to supply its customers in Israel and the region from the Leviathan gas field, another major facility in the Mediterranean Sea. However, the suspension of Tamar’s operations has already cut Israeli gas shipments to Egypt by 20%, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday, citing Egyptian officials. 'If we take out Israeli pipe gas imports from that equation, it will harm the ability of Egypt to export LNG over the coming months,' said Gergely Molnar, an International Energy Agency analyst, according to S&P Global. Dutch TTF natural gas futures closed 12.5% higher at 49.455 euros per megawatt-hour on Tuesday. They are down 41% so far this year.

article_content: Three Delaware daycare workers were arrested after police obtained a disturbing cell phone video allegedly showing two toddlers engaged in a fight organized by the staff. On Tuesday, authorities arrested Tiana Harris, 19; Estefania Myers, 21; and Lisa Parker, 47, charging them with assault, reckless endangerment, endangering the welfare of a child, and conspiracy. The video, which surfaced during an unrelated police investigation on Saturday, depicts the March incident involving two 3-year-old boys. Although the children were not seriously injured, Dover Police Captain Tim Stump said they were 'clearly hurting each other.' According to police, one worker reportedly told a child, 'No pinching, only punching,' after the boy complained of being pinched. The video also shows seven other children seated nearby, some of whom attempted to leave the room—only to be pushed back by a staff member. Stump stated, 'It's not like they didn't know what was going on. They were encouraging them to continue.' Authorities are investigating whether this was an isolated event or part of a pattern, noting that the daycare’s administration appears unaware. Police made the arrests on Monday and informed parents and guardians the same evening. The Delaware Division of Family Services has assigned an institutional abuse investigator to assist with the probe. Agency spokesman Joseph Smack said the women could be barred from working in public-sector roles involving children or seniors, despite having passed background checks prior to employment. 'It's rare to see a case like this where staff actively encouraged this kind of behavior,' he added. Attempts to contact the daycare center were unsuccessful, and its business license has been suspended. The suspects, who have posted $10,000 bail, are awaiting trial. Their attorneys could not be reached for comment.

article_content: A Danish PhD student has been granted £300,000 to study 'actual relationships' with trolls — not internet trolls, but mythical creatures from Danish folklore. Lars Christian Kofoed Rømer, a PhD candidate who has spent two years researching ghost activity, will now investigate how residents of Bornholm interact with local troll legends. The research is funded by the Danish Council for Independent Research (DFF), a state body under the Ministry for Higher Education and Science, with a grant of 2.5 million Danish kroner. Bornholm Island has long promoted itself as a hub of supernatural tourism, drawing visitors with stories of trolls living underground and emerging at night. Kofoed Rømer, who also teaches part-time at the University of Copenhagen’s Department of Anthropology, plans to document how these legends shape community identity and daily life. DFF’s chair, Peter Munk Christiansen, declined to comment on individual projects but emphasized the council’s commitment to humanistic research: 'We believe humanistic inquiry deserves equal funding with other disciplines — and we often prioritize it over purely societal research. We support pluralism, not just popularity.' The funding decision has drawn sharp criticism from some Danes, who point to recent severe cuts in health and welfare services — including the impending loss of thousands of nursing jobs — as evidence of misplaced priorities. Critics argue that spending £300,000 on researching mythical beings is tone-deaf amid economic hardship. DFF has an annual budget of 1.2 billion kroner (£130 million), of which 22.5 million kroner (£2.3 million) supports PhD projects outside the traditional university system — including Kofoed Rømer’s work.

Lars Christian Kofoed Rømer, doktorants, kas divus gadus pētīja garu aktivitātes, tagad pētīs, kā Bornholmas iedzīvotāji interagē ar vietējām troļļu pasakām. Mēs atbalstām pluralitāti, nevis tikai populāritāti.' Finansēšanas lēmums ir izraisījis asu kritiku no dažiem dāņiem, kas norāda uz nesenajām stingrajām samazinājumiem veselības aprūpes un sociālās aizsardzības jomā — tostarp tūkstošiem nursu darba vietu zaudēšanu — kā pierādījumu par nepareizām prioritātēm. article_content: Former UK Prime Minister Tony Blair is reportedly preparing to make a substantial financial donation to the Labour Party as it faces a funding crisis. With his personal wealth estimated in the tens of millions of pounds, Blair is said to be in discussions with Ed Miliband’s team about ways to support the party’s election efforts — with a direct cash contribution being the most anticipated option. However, Labour activist Jon Lansman has publicly opposed such a donation, arguing that Blair’s history of consulting for governments like Kuwait, Kazakhstan, and Qatar makes him 'not the cleanest' figure in British politics. Blair’s allies have sought to temper expectations, citing the high operational costs of his business ventures and charitable foundations. Meanwhile, Labour has been forced to overhaul its funding structure after agreeing to end automatic union contributions. Under the new system, union members must now 'opt in' — a change projected to cost the party between £4 million and £7 million depending on participation rates. Though Blair has donated small amounts in the past — £6,000 in 2009 and 2012, plus a non-cash contribution of £76,000 in 2010 for staff transition support — his potential new gift would mark a dramatic increase. Lord Levy, Blair’s former chief fundraiser, acknowledged the necessity of private donations, stating: 'I don’t think they’ve got any option.' Complicating matters, Blair’s past communication with Rebekah Brooks — during the scandal over the hacking of murdered schoolgirl Milly Dowler’s voicemail — has reignited controversy. In a text message, Blair wrote: 'Is there anything I can do to help you? Thinking of you.' Further unease stems from the Chilcott Report, published in 2014, which concluded that Blair had misled Parliament over the justification for the 2003 Iraq War. Despite these tensions, Blair recently praised Miliband’s union reforms, calling them 'a long overdue reform' and commending his 'courage and leadership.' Miliband’s team declined to confirm talks, stating: 'Donations will be disclosed in the usual way,' while adding: 'Of course all support is welcome.' Separately, it was revealed that Blair has received £500,000 in public funds since leaving office in 2007 — including £230,000 in Public Duty Cost Allowance from 2011 to 2013 — a benefit also granted to former PMs Gordon Brown, Sir John Major, and Baroness Thatcher.

Ar savu personisko bagātību, kas tiek novērtēta desmitiem miljonu lielās britu mārciņās, Bleiru, kā uzskata, apspriež ar Ed Milibenda komandu iespējas, kā atbalstīt partijas vēlēšanu pūli — ar naudas devumu kā visvairāk gaidīto variantu. Tomēr Strādnieku partijas aktivists Jons Lansmens publiski pretoties šādam devumam, argumentējot, ka Bleira vēsture, strādājot ar valstīm kā Kuveita, Kazahstāna un Katar, padara viņu par 'nevis visattīrītāko' figūru britu politikā. Bleira sabiedrotie mēģina samazināt cerības, norādot uz augsto darbības izmaksu līmeni savā biznesa impērijā un fondu. Savukārt Strādnieku partija bija spiesta pārveidot finansējuma modeli, piekrītot beigt automātiskās savienību iemaksas. Jaunajā sistēmā biedriem tagad jāizvēlas 'pievienoties' — šis maiņas solis paredzams, ka izraisīs zaudējumus starp 4 miljoniem un 7 miljoniem britu mārciņām, atkarībā no dalības līmeņa. Lai gan Bleirs iepriekš ir devējis nelielas summas — 6000 britu mārciņas 2009. un 2012. gadā, kā arī 76 000 britu mārciņas nekausētā devumā 2010. gadā darbinieku pārejas atbalstam — viņa potenciālais jaunais devums būtu ievērojams pieaugums. Bleira bijušais galvenais devumu ievācējs Lords Levi atzina privāto devumu nepieciešamību, teikdams: 'Es neuzskatu, ka viņiem ir izvēle.' Sarežģītāks jautājums ir Bleira iepriekšējā saziņa ar Rebeku Bruks — skandāla laikā, kad tika nozagts slepkavotas skolnieces Milijas Dovleras telefona ziņojums. Teksta ziņojumā Bleirs rakstīja: 'Vai ir kaut kas, ko es varu darīt, lai palīdzētu? Domāju par tevi.' Turpmākās bažas rodas no Čilko apmeklējuma ziņojuma, kas tika publicēts 2014. gadā un secināja, ka Bleirs bija vilcinājis Parlamentu attiecībā uz 2003. gada Irākas kara pamatojumu. Neskatoties uz šīm pretrunām, Bleirs nesen apsveica Milibenda savienību reformas, saucot tās par 'ilgi gaidītu reformu' un slavējot viņa 'cīnīgumu un vadītājdarbību.' Milibenda komanda atteicās apstiprināt sarunas, teikdama: 'Devumi tiks atklāti parastajā veidā,' bet piebilda: 'Protams, visi atbalsti ir sveicinati.' Tāpat tika atklāts, ka Bleirs ir saņēmis 500 000 britu mārciņas no nodokļu maksātājiem kopš 2007. gada, kad viņš atstāja amatu — tostarp 230 000 britu mārciņas sabiedriskās pienākumu izmaksu atlīdzības formā no 2011. līdz 2013. gadam — labumu, ko saņēma arī bijušie premjerministri Gordon Brāuns, Sirs Džons Mājors un Baroneise Tečere.

article_content: In the months following the fatal shooting of unarmed teenager Michael Brown in Ferguson, Missouri, at least five prominent TV journalists — including Anderson Cooper, Don Lemon, Matt Lauer, George Stephanopoulos, and Scott Pelley — held private, off-the-record meetings with Officer Darren Wilson. Wilson, who has avoided public view since the incident, reportedly met with these anchors not to give interviews, but to gauge whether he might be willing to speak on camera. According to sources cited by CNN’s Brian Stelter, these sessions were primarily one-sided: Wilson listened more than he spoke, using the time to become familiar with the journalists before making any decision. Both Cooper and Lemon later confirmed the meetings on Twitter, stressing they were routine in broadcast journalism — similar to how Cooper once met with Donald Sterling before interviewing him. Cooper emphasized there was no hidden agenda, noting he’d also interviewed Brown’s family and their lawyers multiple times. 'Reporters want to talk to people,' he wrote. 'Sometimes you have to meet them first.' Meanwhile, the grand jury investigating the case remains silent, with no public timeline for its verdict. Protests have continued nightly, though they’ve remained largely peaceful. Missouri Governor Jay Nixon has deployed the National Guard, a move criticized by activists as excessive. Attorney Benjamin Crump expressed disbelief that prosecutors hadn’t recommended charges, calling it unprecedented in his two-decade career. As tensions simmer, community leaders like Reverend Tommie Pierson urged residents to stay united and engaged, reminding them: 'You live in a democracy; you must participate.' Brown’s mother, Lesley McSpadden, echoed that call for peace, regardless of the jury’s outcome.

Vilsuns, kurš kopš incidenta ir izvairījies no sabiedriskās uzmanības, pēc informācijas, kas atsaukas uz CNN žurnālista Briana Steltera avotiem, šajās sarunās vairāk klausījās nekā runāja, lai iepazītu žurnālistus pirms lēmuma pieņemšanas par iespējamu interviju. article_content: For millions of fans, the annual showdown between the New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks is the Super Bowl. But for businesses not officially licensed by the NFL, calling it that could mean legal trouble. To avoid trademark infringement, companies—from small diners to national chains—are avoiding the term entirely, opting instead for phrases like 'the big game' or 'game day.' At Coney Island Grill in Phoenix, owner Tyler Ellis sells tie-dye shirts labeled 'Coney Island 2015' and 'the big game'—a clever workaround that stays within the rules. Even major brands like Whole Foods and American Airlines steer clear of 'Super Bowl' on signage and social media, despite being involved in the event’s host committee or airport operations. The NFL doesn’t go after every minor use—chalkboard menus or news reports are fine—but anything resembling commercial promotion risks a cease-and-desist letter. Trademark experts say this tight control isn’t just about legality; it’s a business strategy. By keeping the term exclusive, the NFL protects significant sponsorship deals for beer, snacks, and other products. Other organizations, like the U.S. Olympic Committee and FIFA, operate under similar rules, showing how fiercely sports bodies guard their branding. As one lawyer put it, the goal isn’t to punish small businesses—it’s to make sure no one even thinks about stepping too close to the line.
translated_content: Miljonu fanu domā, ka ikgadējais sastapšanās starp Njūenglandas Patriots un Sīetla Sīhkens ir Super Bowl. Bet uzņēmumiem, kas nav oficiāli licencēti NFL, šīs izteiksmes lietošana var nozīmēt juridiskus riskus. Lai izvairītos no preču zīmes pārkāpuma, uzņēmumi — no maziem restorāniem līdz nacionālām ķēdēm — pilnībā izvairās no šī termina, izmantojot vietā frāzes kā 'lielā spēle' vai 'spēles diena'. Fīnikas restorānā Coney Island Grill īpašnieks Tайлers Elliss pārdod krāsainas tīģera džinsa krekli ar uzrakstu 'Coney Island 2015' un 'lielā spēle' — gudrs risinājums, kas atbilst likumam. Pat lielas kompānijas, piemēram, Whole Foods un American Airlines, izvairās no izteiksmes 'Super Bowl' uz izkārtojumiem un sociālajos tīklos, neskatoties uz to, ka tās ir iesaistītas sacensību organizēšanā vai lidostas darbībā. NFL neuzskata par pārkāpumu mazākas lietošanas formas — piemēram, kalkulācijas uz baltām tabulām vai ziņu mediji — bet jebkurš komerciāls izmantojums var izraisīt aizlieguma vēstuli. Tirdzniecības zīmju eksperti saka, ka šis stingrā kontroles veids nav tikai par likumību, bet arī par biznesa stratēģiju. Turējot terminu ekskluzīvu, NFL aizsargā savus ievērojamus sponsorēšanas līgumus ar alu, čipsiem un citām preču kategorijām. Citas organizācijas, piemēram, ASV Olimpiskā komiteja un FIFA, darbojas pēc līdzīgiem noteikumiem, rādot, cik aizstāvīgi sporta organizācijas aizsargā savus brandus. Kā viens advokāts teica, mērķis nav sodīt mazus uzņēmumus — tas ir nodrošināt, lai neviens pat nepārdomātu, ka tuvojas robežai.

article_content: Amid growing strains within the opposition INDIA bloc ahead of five state assembly elections, Congress sources said the December 3 results could serve as 'Fevicol'—binding the alliance together. The way forward, they added, will be determined after campaigning ends on November 28. Congress officials insist the party remains the core unifying force of the INDIA bloc, arguing that a strong Congress performance will directly strengthen the entire alliance. The party is targeting victories in Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, and Mizoram. A senior Congress leader stated, 'After December 3, everyone will come together and align like Fevicol—not just strengthening Congress, but the entire bloc.' He emphasized that the INDIA alliance was explicitly formed for the Lok Sabha elections, not for state polls. 'No one ever discussed state-level seat-sharing,' he noted. Tensions have surfaced between Congress and the Samajwadi Party (SP) over seat allocation in Madhya Pradesh, where both parties are fielding candidates independently despite belonging to the same opposition coalition. The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) is also contesting separately in three states, further straining relations. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav accused Congress of seeking to erase socialist ideology, claiming, 'We will not let the socialist legacy end.' He referenced Ram Manohar Lohia and his father, Mulayam Singh Yadav, as guardians of this tradition, and criticized Congress for abandoning socialist allies. Congress responded by stating that Yadav’s comments were inappropriate and that Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge may reach out to him and Ramgopal Yadav. However, Congress reaffirmed that the alliance was never intended for state elections. There are also internal inconsistencies regarding the bloc’s decision to boycott certain TV anchors. While a list exists, Congress leaders in Madhya Pradesh have granted interviews to anchors on the list, undermining the policy’s credibility. Congress sources also indicated that a second edition of the Bharat Jodo Yatra remains under consideration—but only in a hybrid format, combining physical and digital outreach.

Lai gan saraksts eksistē, Kungu līderi Madhja Pradēšā ir devuši intervijas žurnālistiem, kas ir sarakstā, zemākot politikas ticamību. article_content: Brentford delivered a stunning attacking display, firing 42 shots on goal in a commanding 4-0 victory over Blackpool. Four of those efforts found the net, with 14 on target — including a hat-trick from striker Jon Toral. Despite the overwhelming performance, manager Mark Warburton is set to leave at the end of the season. His departure comes just one year after guiding Brentford from League One to the Championship, raising eyebrows among fans and analysts alike. Toral opened the scoring in the 16th minute with a close-range finish after a precise pass from Jonathan Douglas. Two minutes later, he doubled the lead with a well-placed header from Andre Gray’s cross. Blackpool’s defensive struggles were compounded by a first-half red card for Charles Dunne, who was sent off for a reckless challenge on Jota. Andre Gray extended Brentford’s advantage in the 52nd minute, capitalizing on a saved volley to slot home the rebound. The home side continued to press, with Alex Pritchard and Gray both coming close. Toral completed his hat-trick in the 89th minute with a simple tap-in, sealing a dominant night at Griffin Park. Blackpool, rooted to the bottom of the table and 12 points from safety, offered little resistance. Their manager, Lee Clark, watched helplessly as his team was overrun. Brentford owner Matthew Benham insists the decision to part ways with Warburton aligns with the club’s long-term vision. Yet, with such a convincing performance under his leadership, many wonder if replacing him was a premature and misguided move.

article_content: Massive pipes wind through chambers filled with rusting machinery, evoking the eerie atmosphere of Ridley Scott’s Alien — but this is no movie set. This is Pyestock, the former National Gas Turbine Establishment in Fleet, Hampshire, once the crown jewel of British aerospace engineering. Opened after World War II, Pyestock led global research and testing of gas turbines and jet engines for over five decades. Engines for the V-bombers, Harrier, Tornado, and Concorde were pushed to their limits here — including Concorde’s Olympus 593 engines, tested at 2,000 mph and simulated altitudes of 60,000 feet. The Royal Navy relied on Pyestock to certify its gas turbines, and during the Cold War, captured Soviet engines were meticulously studied within its walls. After its closure in 2000, the site was left untouched — equipment frozen in time, jet engines gathering dust, control panels still intact. Graphic designer Matt Emmett has visited the abandoned complex ten times, spending over 75 hours documenting its haunting beauty. 'Standing here, the past feels real,' Emmett says. 'You can almost hear the roar of turbines or see engineers watching gauges, hearts pounding as supersonic tests begin.' Today, Pyestock is a magnet for urban explorers — but not for long. Demolition is imminent. The site will be reborn as Hartland Park, a vast retail distribution center expected to create 1,600 jobs. More than 12,000 locals protested the plan, warning it would destroy a vital green corridor between Fleet and Farnborough and overwhelm local roads. Yet developers argue the economic need outweighs preservation. For Emmett, Pyestock’s impending destruction isn’t just about losing buildings — it’s the erasure of a legacy. 'We willingly let go of something that once led the world,' he reflects. 'Now we’re outsourcing innovation. This wasn’t just a factory — it was the beating heart of British ingenuity.' Even the smallest details — faded posters of RAF might, dials from the 1950s, air dryers made by Ceca Ltd — whisper of an era when Britain built the future. Now, silence reigns. Only the drip of water and flutter of birds break the quiet.
translated_content: Lielas caurules vītās caur telpām, kas piepildītas ar rūsējošu iekārtu, izraisa bažas, kas atgādina Ridli Skota filmu 'Alien' — bet šis nav kino scenārijs. Šis ir Piestoks, bijušais Nacionālais gāzes turbīnu uzstādījums Fleetā, Hampšīrā, reiz bijis lielākais britu aerosofta inženierijas cietoksnis. Atvērts pēc Otrā pasaules kara, Piestoks vairāk nekā piecdesmit gadus vadīja globālo gāzes turbīnu un reaktīvo dzinēju pētījumu un testēšanu. Šeit tika pārbaudīti V-bombu, Harrier un Tornado dzinēji, ieskaitot Concorde Olympus 593 dzinējus, kas testēti ar ātrumu 2000 km/h un 60 000 pēdu augstumā. Karalis jūras flote balstījās uz Piestoku, lai apstiprinātu savas gāzes turbīnas, un aukstā kara laikā tika pētīti iegūtie padomju dzinēji. Pēc slēgšanas 2000. gadā vieta palika neatkarīga — iekārtas kā laika pārtraukums, reaktīvie dzinēji krāsojas ar rūsu, vadības paneli vēl joprojām saglabāti. Grafiskais dizainers Mets Emmets ir apmeklējis šo aizmirsto kompleksu desmit reizes, pavadot vairāk nekā 75 stundas, dokumentējot tās briesmīgo skaistumu. 'Stāvot šeit, pagātne šķiet reāla,' saka Emmets. 'Tu vari gandrīz dzirdēt turbīnu rūkošanu vai redzēt inženierus, kas skatās uz mērītājiem, sirdis sitas, kad tiek veikti superskaņas testi.' Šodien Piestoks ir pievilcīgs vietu pētnieku mērķis — bet ne ilgi. Demolēšana ir tuvu. Vieta tiks pārveidota par Hartland Park, plašu tirdzniecības sadalīšanas centru, kas paredzēts radīt 1600 darbavietas. Vairāk nekā 12 000 vietējo iedzīvotāju protestēja pret plānu, brīdinot, ka tas iznīcinās svarīgu zaļo joslā starp Fleetu un Farnboru un pārspīlēs jau pārpilnīgās ceļu sistēmas. Tomēr attīstītāji argumentē, ka ekonomiskā nepieciešamība pārsver saglabāšanu. Emmetam Piestoka tuvojošās iznīcināšanas nozīme nav tikai zaudējums ēkām — tā ir mantojuma izdzēšana. 'Mēs apzināti atstājām kaut ko, kas reiz vadīja pasauli,' viņš refleksē. 'Tagad mēs uzticamies citām valstīm inovāciju veidošanai. Tas nebija vienkārši rūpnīca — tas bija britu izgudrotības sirds.' Pat nelielākie detaļas — pazuduši RAF spēka plakāti, 1950. gadu mērītāji, Ceca Ltd ražoti gaisa žāvētāji — šepš, kā Anglija bija uzbūvējusi nākotni. Tagad valda klusums. Tikai ūdens pilšana un putnu spārnu rāvieni traucē klusumu.

article_content: By Sam Greenhill and Daniel Martin. Published: 14:09 EST, 12 December 2012. Updated: 05:54 EST, 13 December 2012. David Cameron’s director of communications, Craig Oliver, was accused yesterday of warning the Daily Telegraph not to publish a story exposing that Culture Secretary Maria Miller’s parents lived in her taxpayer-funded second home. Oliver reportedly called the newspaper’s editor, Tony Gallagher, last Friday, suggesting the story was ill-timed given that Miller was actively engaged in implementing the Leveson Inquiry’s recommendations on press regulation. He allegedly added that Miller was considering filing a complaint with the Press Complaints Commission. Joanna Hindley, Miller’s special adviser, also referenced Miller’s involvement in Leveson-related meetings, telling the Telegraph: 'Maria has obviously been having quite a lot of editors’ meetings around Leveson at the moment. So I am just going to kind of flag up that connection for you to think about.' The Telegraph investigated Miller for claiming £90,000 in expenses for a South London property where her parents resided — a practice previously criticized in 2009 when Labour minister Tony McNulty was reprimanded for similar conduct. Miller’s office claimed the newspaper harassed her elderly father, who was briefly spoken to by reporters at the property. Downing Street dismissed accusations of intimidation as 'ridiculous,' stating Oliver’s call was made to express concern over the distress caused to Miller during a busy period that included Leveson duties. The newspaper had formally contacted Miller’s office on Thursday before publishing; Hindley’s remarks were not denied by her department. The controversy unfolded as James Harding resigned as editor of The Times, following pressure from News Corp, owned by Rupert Murdoch. Harding, who led The Times for five years, said he stepped down after being informed that News Corp wished to appoint a new editor. Critics, including MPs Douglas Carswell and John Mann, condemned the government’s actions as an attack on press freedom, comparing them to authoritarian tactics. The Prime Minister’s spokesperson defended the interaction, saying Hindley raised 'legitimate concerns' about how the investigation was conducted.

Dēvida Kemerona komunikācijas direktors Krēgs Olivers tika apsūdzēts, ka iepriekš brīdināja 'Daili Tēlegrāfu' nepublicēt ziņu par to, ka Kultūras ministres Marijas Millers vecāki dzīvo viņas valsts finansētajā otrajā mājā. Olivers pēc ziņām zvanīja avīzes redaktoram Tonijam Gāligēram pagājušo piektdien, ieteikdams, ka šī ziņa ir nederīgi laikā, ņemot vērā, ka Miller aktīvi iesaistīta Levesona izmeklēšanas ieteikumu īstenošanā preses regulēšanā. Viņš, pēc ziņām, piebilda, ka Miller apsvērtu sūdzības iesniegšanu Preses saskaņošanas komisijai. Millers speciālā padomniece Joanna Hindley arī atsaucās uz Miller iesaisti Levesona saistītajās sanāksmēs, teikdama 'Daili Tēlegrāfam': 'Marija, protams, ir bijusi ļoti daudz redaktoru sanāksmju ap Levesonu pašlaik. Tāpēc es vienkārši gribu norādīt šo saikni, lai jūs par to padomātu.' 'Daili Tēlegrāfs' izmeklēja Milleri par to, ka viņa prasa 90 000 GBP izdevumus par Dienvidlondonas īpašumu, kurā dzīvoja viņas vecāki — prakse, ko 2009. gadā kritizēja, kad strādāja Labour ministrs Tonija Maknulti. Ministres birojs apgalvoja, ka avīze izturējās neattiecīgi pret viņas seniem vecākiem, kas tika īsi sarunāti ar reportieriem īpašumā. Daugingstrīts noraidīja apsūdzības par piespiedu, saucot tās par 'absurdām', norādot, ka Oliversa zvana mērķis bija izteikt bažas par Miller ietekmi, kas bija nodarbināta ar Levesona pienākumiem. Avīze bija oficiāli sazinājusies ar Miller biroju ceturtdien, pirms publikācijas; Hindley piezīmes netika noraidītas no tās puses. Vairākas kontroverzes izcelšanās sakarā ar Džejmsa Hardinga atkāpšanos no 'Taimsa' redaktora amata pēc spiediena no News Corp, kas pieder Rupert Murdočam. Hardings, kurš vadīja 'Taimsu' piecus gadus, teica, ka atkāpjas, pēc tam kad viņam paziņoja, ka News Corp vēlas iecelt jaunu redaktoru. Kritiķi, ieskaitot deputātus Dāglastu Karzvelu un Džonu Manu, apsprieda valdības darbību kā uzbrukumu preses brīvībai, salīdzinot to ar autoritāriem taktikām. Premjerministra pārstāvis aizstāvēja šo interakciju, teikdams, ka Hindley izteica 'legitīmas bažas' par to, kā tika veikta izmeklēšana.

article_content: Islamabad, Pakistan (CNN) — A young female suicide bomber killed at least 46 people and injured 105 others in a blast at a food distribution checkpoint in Khar, Bajaur Agency, Pakistan, an official said Sunday. Zakir Hussain Afridi, the top government official in Bajaur Agency, said preliminary investigations indicate the attacker was a girl between the ages of 16 and 18, identified from recovered remains. The Pakistani Taliban claimed responsibility for Saturday’s attack, stating it targeted individuals forming what they called a pro-government, anti-Taliban group. According to Amjad Jamal, a spokesperson for the UN World Food Programme (WFP), the explosion occurred approximately 600 meters from a WFP distribution point, where more than 300 people were undergoing security screening to receive food and supplies. Khar serves as the headquarters of Bajaur Agency, one of seven districts in Pakistan’s tribal region bordering Afghanistan. Residents displaced by recent military operations in the area receive monthly food rations. Afridi said the bomber was wearing a burqa — a traditional full-body garment worn by some Muslim women — and detonated herself after being stopped for a routine security check. While Afridi described this as the first female suicide bombing he could recall in Pakistan, international media have documented at least one prior case: a woman who detonated explosives in Peshawar in 2007, as reported by The New York Times. Azam Tariq, the Pakistani Taliban’s central spokesman, denied the bomber was female, saying, 'We have thousands of male suicide bombers ready who are keenly waiting for their turns. Why would we use a woman, which goes against Islamic traditions?' Jamal confirmed that all WFP staff and partners are safe, but all four of the agency’s food distribution points in Bajaur Agency have been temporarily closed for security reasons. The WFP will continue operations elsewhere in Pakistan. U.S. President Barack Obama condemned the attack as 'an outrageous terrorist act,' calling it 'an affront to the people of Pakistan and to all humanity.' He affirmed U.S. support for Pakistan’s efforts toward peace, security, and justice. The bombing came a day after approximately 150 militants attacked five security checkpoints in Mohmand Agency, another tribal district along the Afghan border, killing 11 soldiers. In response, security forces killed 40 militants, including 24 on Friday and 16 on Saturday, using helicopter gunships to strike militant hideouts.
translated_content: Islamābād, Pakistāns (CNN) — Jauna sieviešu pašnāvnieks nogalināja vismaz 46 cilvēkus un ievainoja 105 citus, uzspridzinoties uz ēdienu izplatīšanas punktu Kharā, Bajaura aģentūrā, Pakistānā, paziņoja amatpersona svētdien. Zakirs Husains Afridi, augstākā valsts amatpersona Bajaura aģentūrā, teica, ka sākotnējā izmeklēšana liecina, ka uzbrucēja bija meitene starp 16 un 18 gadiem, ko identificēja pēc atgūtajiem atliekām. Pakistānas talibāni piekrita atbildību par sestdienas uzbrukumu, norādot, ka tā bija vērsta pret cilvēkiem, kas veidoja, kā viņi sauca, provaldības, anti-talibānu grupu. Saskaņā ar ASV Pasaules ēdiena programmas (WFP) pārstāvi Amjadu Džamalu, uzspridziena notika apmēram 600 metrus no WFP izplatīšanas punkta, kur vairāk nekā 300 cilvēki bija caur drošības pārbaudi, lai saņemtu ēdienu un citus preces. Khar ir Bajaura aģentūras centrs, viena no septiņām distriktiem Pakistānas tribālajā reģionā, kas robežojas ar Afganistānu. Iedzīvotāji, kas tika izstādīti pēc nesenajām militārajām operācijām šajā reģionā, saņem mēneša racionu ēdiena. Afridi teica, ka uzbrucēja bija apvilkta burkā — tradicionāls pilns ķermeņa segums, ko dažas musulmaņu sievietes valkā — un uzspridzinājās pēc tam, kad tika apturēta drošības pārbaudē. Lai gan Afridi aprakstīja šo kā pirmo sieviešu pašnāvnieka uzbrukumu, ko viņš varēja atcerēties Pakistānā, starptautiskās mediju avoti ir dokumentējuši vismaz vienu iepriekšēju gadījumu: sieviete, kas uzspridzināja eksplozīvus Peshavārā 2007. gadā, kā ziņoja Ņujorkas laikraksts. Azams Tariqs, Pakistānas talibānu centrālais runātājs, atteicās, ka uzbrucēja bija sieviete, sakot: 'Mums ir tūkstošiem vīriešu pašnāvnieku, kas gaida savu kārtu. Kāpēc mēs lietotu sievieti, kas ir pretī islāma tradīcijām?' Džamals apstiprināja, ka visi WFP darbinieki un partneri ir droši, bet visi četri organizācijas ēdiena izplatīšanas punkti Bajaura aģentūrā ir pagaidu slēgti drošības iemesliem. WFP turpinās darbību citur Pakistānā. ASV prezidents Baraks Obama apsprieda uzbrukumu kā 'absolūti neapmierinošu teroristisko akciju', saucot to par 'sāpīgu izsaukumu Pakistānas cilvēkiem un visai cilvēcībai.' Viņš apsolīja ASV atbalstu Pakistānas pūlēm nodrošināt mieru, drošību un tiesīgumu. Uzspridziena notika dienu pēc tam, kad aptuveni 150 militanti uzbruka pieciem drošības punktiem Mohmandas aģentūrā — citā tribālajā distriktā pie Afganistānas robežas — nogalinot 11 karavīrus. Reakcijā drošības spēki nogalināja 40 militantu, no tiem 24 pirmdien un 16 sestdien, izmantojot helikopterus ar bumbu šaujamierīcēm, lai uzbruktu militantu paslēptuvēm.

article_content: Losing a beloved dog can feel like losing a family member. One artist has found a heartfelt way to comfort grieving pet owners: Lucy Francis Maloney creates hyper-realistic miniature replicas of deceased dogs. At 61, Lucy uses nothing more than an old photograph to 'resurrect' pets as tiny, lifelike mementos. She lives in Saint Paul, Minnesota, and first began crafting these miniatures in 1997 after her family’s Yorkshire terrier, Old Ted, passed away. Using materials like yarn, chicken wire, alpaca wool, cashmere, baby camel hair, and occasionally real dog hair, she meticulously recreates each animal’s unique appearance. Glass eyes and hand-groomed fur complete the uncanny realism. Since then, she has created thousands of these sculptures. Clients from the Netherlands, Russia, Qatar, Germany, and the UK pay between $200 (£132) and $2,000 (£1,326) for her custom pieces through her website. Her work has drawn attention from celebrities including Martha Stewart, Andrew WK, Shirley MacLaine, John Prine, and Keith Sykes — all seeking a tangible keepsake of their departed pets. Lucy says her lifelong passion for dogs, combined with personal experience of pet loss, drives her mission: 'I know the pain. I want to help.' She also creates miniatures of living dogs, and recently received a deeply moving request: a mother asked her to make a replica of her son’s dog, who died suddenly before his fourth deployment to Afghanistan with Special Forces. The miniature will accompany him overseas. 'A photograph is flat,' Lucy explains. 'But a three-dimensional replica lets people hold, touch, and remember their pet in a way that feels alive.' Many customers are moved to tears upon receiving their sculpture. Lucy says her work is more than art — it’s healing. 'When a dog is brought back in such a real way, emotions surface. I strive to make each one perfect — because they deserve nothing less.' Learn more at www.lucyfrancismaloney.com.

article_content: Sportsmail tennis correspondent Mike Dickson believes the windy conditions at this year’s Australian Open could give Andy Murray an advantage in his semi-final clash against Tomas Berdych. The British No. 1 secured his place in the last four with a convincing win over local favorite Nick Kyrgios, setting up a showdown with the in-form No. 7 seed, who has yet to drop a set in the tournament. The two have met before in a Grand Slam semi-final — at the 2012 US Open, where Murray triumphed in similarly blustery conditions en route to the title. Dickson argues that Murray’s proven ability to thrive under adverse weather could prove decisive, though he expects the match to be tightly contested, possibly extending to five sets. Adding a personal dimension, Murray will face Dani Vallverdu, his longtime friend and former training partner, who now coaches Berdych. Murray celebrated after advancing to the semifinals in Melbourne.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) — Do you know your 'futtock' from your 'baggywrinkle'? A sailor perches on the 'widow-maker' — the bowsprit of his yacht. If these terms sound foreign, don’t worry: sailing is full of unusual jargon. MainSail has compiled a list of 10 of the strangest nautical words that are sure to spark curiosity — and maybe even impress your friends on the dock. Scuttlebutt: Originally a cask holding fresh water on board, the 'scuttlebutt' got its name from 'butt' (a barrel) that was 'scuttled' — drilled with a hole — to access water. Sailors gathered here to chat, turning the word into slang for gossip. Rowlocks (sometimes misspelled as 'rollocks'): U-shaped fittings or notches on a boat’s gunwale that hold oars in place during rowing. Poop deck: Located at the stern, this elevated deck is typically the roof of a cabin. When a wave crashes over it from behind, sailors say the vessel has been 'pooped.' Widow-maker: A colloquial name for the bowsprit — the horizontal spar extending from the bow. Its dangerous reputation stems from sailors falling from it while handling sails. Baggywrinkle: A soft, braided covering wrapped around rigging to prevent sails from chafing against rough lines. Mainsheet: The control line attached to the boom that adjusts the angle of the main sail, directly influencing boat speed. Bilge: The lowest inner part of a ship’s hull, where water collects below the floorboards and below the waterline. Futtock: Curved wooden beams forming the internal rib structure of traditional wooden ship hulls. Cat-head: A heavy, angled timber projecting from the bow, used to support and maneuver the anchor. Some feature carved lion or cat faces — though it’s unclear if the name inspired the carvings, or vice versa. Escutcheon: The ornamental plate on a ship’s stern where the vessel’s name is displayed.
translated_content: LONDONS, Anglijā (CNN) — Vai zināt savu 'futtock' no 'baggywrinkle'? Jūrnieks stāv uz 'nāves radītāja' — kuģa borta sprīta. Ja šie termini jums ir sveši, neuztraucieties: jūrniecībā ir daudz dīvainu žargona vārdiem. MainSail ir sagatavojusi sarakstu ar 10 no dīvainākajām jūrnieku terminām, kas noteikti izraisīs interesi — un varbūt pat iedvesmos jūsu draugus pie krasta. Scuttlebutt: Sākotnēji tā bija koka bļoda ar ūdeni uz kuģa. Vārds 'scuttlebutt' radies no 'butt' (bļodas), kurā bija izdarīts 'scuttle' — caurums, lai piekļūtu ūdenim. Jūrnieki sapulcējās ap šo bļodu, lai sarunātos, un vārds kļuva par žargona nozīmi — čukstus vai baumas. Rowlocks (dažreiz kļūdaini rakstīti kā 'rollocks'): U-formas fiksatori vai griezumi kuģa pārsegumā, kas uztur mācības vietā, kad kuģis tiek vilkts ar mācībām. Poop deck: Atrodas kuģa sternā, parasti tas ir kabinata jumts. Kad viļņi nokrīt uz šo klāju no aizmugures, jūrnieki saka, ka kuģis ir 'pooped'. Widow-maker: Sarunvaloda, kas nozīmē kuģa borta sprīti — horizontālo sprīti, kas izstiepts no priekšpuses. Tās bīstamā reputācija rodas no jūrnieku nāvēm, kas krita ar to. Baggywrinkle: Mīksta, plūkotā apvalka, kas apvilkts ap rīgi, lai novērstu velnu trīsēšanu. Mainsheet: Kontroles aukla, kas piestiprināta pie boom, lai regulētu galvenās velns leņķi, tieši ietekmējot kuģa ātrumu. Bilge: Zemākā iekšējā kuģa korpusa daļa, kur ūdens krājas zem grīdas desku un zem ūdens līnijas. Futtock: Ieliektais koka stienis, kas veido iekšējos ribas tradicionālajos koka kuģu korpusos. Cat-head: Smags, slīpi izstiepts koka stienis, kas izstiepts no kuģa priekšpuses, lai palīdzētu pacelt un nolaist kotru. Daži ir rotāti ar lāča vai citas lielas kaķa sejām — tomēr nav zināms, vai nosaukums radās no šīm gleznām, vai otrādi. Escutcheon: Dekoratīvā plāksne kuģa sternā, kur ir uzrakstīts kuģa nosaukums.

article_content: A dramatic stoppage-time goal by Moussa Sow sealed a 2-1 comeback victory for Senegal over Ghana in their Africa Cup of Nations Group C opener in Mongomo. Sow, introduced as a substitute in the 79th minute, pounced on a loose ball at the back post to score with the final kick of the game, sparking wild celebrations among Senegal’s players and fans. Before the stunning finale, Senegal had fought back from an early deficit. Ghana opened the scoring in the 14th minute through a penalty converted by Andre Ayew, awarded after Christian Atsu beat goalkeeper Bouna Coundoul with pace and composure. The goal forced Senegal to open up, and they responded with energy — particularly through Stoke City striker Mame Biram Diouf, who equalized in the 58th minute. Diouf reacted fastest to a header that struck the crossbar, tapping in the rebound to level the score. Diouf nearly added a second moments later, missing a simple chance with a wild left-footed swing, and earlier in the half, he had a spectacular bicycle kick saved brilliantly by Ghana’s keeper Brimah Razak. Senegal’s set pieces also posed a constant threat, with Serigne Mbodji hitting the crossbar with a powerful header. Ghana, under manager Avram Grant, sat deep after taking the lead, but their defense struggled to cope with Senegal’s pace and pressure. Both teams squandered clear opportunities in the final 15 minutes — Pape Kouyate dragged a shot wide, and Jordan Ayew headed over from close range — until Sow’s heroics decided the match. Despite a notoriously poor pitch — the second subpar surface in as many days at the tournament — the atmosphere in Mongomo was electric. Fans in colorful attire filled the jungle stadium, roaring with passion throughout. The match ended in heartbreak for Ghana, but it delivered a thrilling start to AFCON 2015.

Uzbrucējs ieguva vārtus ar pēdējo spēles brīdi, nodrošinot uzvaru. Sow, kas tika ievietots kā aizstājējs 79. minūtē, bija pareizajā vietā pareizajā laikā, lai iegūtu vārtus no aizmugures staba ar sekundēm atlikušām spēlē — un šis vārts iznīcināja Ghanas cerības. Pirms dramatiskās beigām centrā bija Premjerlīgas zvaigznes, kad divas no Āfrikas visvairāk zvaigžņotajām komandām spēlēja izkaisītu spēli Mongomo. Senegālas spēlētāji un aizstājēji svinēja pēc Moussa Sow pēdējā uzvara spēlē. Aizstājējs Sow (labais), kurš spēlē klubā Fenerbahçe, ievadīja vārtus garām Ghanas vārtsargam Brimah Razak. Mame Biram Diouf no Stoke City ieguva līdzsvaru Senegālam pēc tam, kad Gana bija ieguvusi pirmās puses vadību caur sodu, ko ieguva Evertona Christian Atsu. Diouf, kas bija dzīvs visā spēlē, bija ātrākais reaģēt, kad viņa galvas spēks atgriezās no staba 57. minūtē, ievadot vārtus no tuvuma. Patiesībā, ātrs uzbrucējs varēja būt ieguvis vairāk nekā vienu vārtu. Pirmajā puslaikā Diouf redzēja spektakulāru kāju metienu, ko saglabāja Ghanas vārtsargs Razak Brimah, noraidot to, kas būtu bijis agrs kandidāts uz sezonas labāko vārtu. Tad, tikai minūtes pēc viņa līdzsvara, viņš izlaizīja vienkāršu iespēju, sviedzot ar kreiso kāju pāri krustojumam no tuvuma. Turnīra 'nāves grupā' neviena komanda nevarēja atļauties zaudējumu pirmajā spēlē, un abas šķita sagatavotas izvairīties no zaudējuma, nevis cīnīties par uzvaru, sākotnējos posmos. Senegāls īpaši gribēja sēdēt atpakaļ un izmantot Stoke Diouf ātrumu uz brīvās spēles. Iepriekš spēlē Stoke uzbrucējs Mame Biram Diouf (otrais pa kreisi) bija līdzsvarojis rezultātu 1–1. Ghanas spēlētāji svinēja pēc tam, kad Andre Ayew ieguva agru sodu, lai ievadītu 1–0 uzvaru pret Senegālu. Ayew (otrais pa kreisi) ievada sodu sākotnējās fāzēs, lai ievadītu Ghanu uz priekšu Group C atklāšanā. Bet Andre Ayew 12. minūtes sods mainīja visu. Tas tika iegūts ar Atsu, uzbrucēju no Chelsea, kas parādīja ātrumu, lai sasniedzu Emmanuel Badu-Agyemang caurlaidi pirms Senegālas vārtsarga Bouna Coundoul, kas to nolieca. Ayew, vadot Ghanu Asamoah Gyan klātbūtnē — trūkst ar malariju — ievadīja vārtus pa vidu un steidzās tieši uz krēslu, lai svinētu ar savām komandas biedriem. Šis vārts nozīmēja, ka Senegālam bija jāiziet no savām apvalkiem, atstājot telpu Atsu un abiem Ayew uzbrukšanai. Tas bija Jordan Ayew, kurš bija visvairāk izdevīgs, vienu reizi uzkārtojot Atsu pēc brauciena, taču uzbrucējs salieca šāvienu tieši ārpusi. Ayew (labais) izplatīja rokas svinot pēc tam, kad viņš ievadīja savu valsti uz priekšu Āfrikas Nāciju kausā. Avram Grants, bijušais Čelsejas treneris, pašlaik ir Ghanas galvenais treneris Āfrikas Nāciju kausā 2015. 2015. gada Āfrikas Nāciju kausa sākums bija labs Ayew un Ghanai ar agru vārtu pret Senegālu. Bet Alaina Giresse Senegālas komanda, lai gan nebija īpaši skaista, izskatījās bīstama — īpaši uz fiksētiem sitieniem. Centra aizsargs Serigne Mbodji ievadīja galvu pret krustojumu pirms Diouf piespieda Brimah saglabāt ar spektakulāru kāju metienu. Neviens no abām komandām netika palīdzēts ar slikto laukumu, otrā komanda turnīrā divos dienas. Bobble noraidīja Senegālas Stephane Badji agru iespēju, pirms vēlāk pirmajā puslaikā Coundoul bija laime, ka viņš nokļuva kontaktā ar ļoti bobblējošu atpakaļpārsūtījumu, ko viņš spēja nogriezt kā leņķi. Senegālas pussargs Mohammed Rabiu (labais) skrien prom no Papakouli Diop izaicinājuma. Diouf (labais), Senegālas līdzsvara vārtu autors, cīnās ar Ghanas Daniel Amartey spēlē. Amartey (kreisais) kontrolē bumbu Āfrikas Nāciju kausa Group C atklāšanā Mongomo. Bet vēl bija daudz, ko apsveikt par džungļu stadionu attālajā pilsētā Mongomo, kas bija pilna ar trokšņainiem un krāsaini apģērbtiem skatītājiem. Otrajā puslaikā viņi redzēja Senegālas uzbrukumu, kad Avram Grant komanda sēdēja uz sava priekšrocības. Bet Gana nekad neatrādīja drošību aizsardzībā, un Diouf vārti, kad tie nāca, nebija pārsteigums. Abām komandām bija iespējas beigu posmā: Pape Kouly Diop braucot cauri neeksistējošai Ghanas aizsardzībai, pirms vilka šāvienu ārpus no šūnas, pirms Jordan Ayew ievadīja galvu ārpus septiņu jardu attālumā. Bet šķita, ka abām būs jāierobežojas ar punktu, līdz dramatiskais Sow pēdējais uzvara. Ghanas fanu skaļi runāja, kad viņi skatījās uz savu komandu, kas ieguva agru priekšrocību Ekvatoriālajā Gvinejā. Viens fans bija nokrāsojis sevi Ghanas karoga krāsās, kad viņš skatījās no laukuma malas.

article_content: By Sonia Perez Diaz (AP) and Steve Nolan. PUBLISHED: 06:46 EST, 3 July 2013 | UPDATED: 07:48 EST, 3 July 2013. Watching anthropologists painstakingly uncover makeshift graves of their loved ones, the Ixil Mayan people of Guatemala are confronted with the horrifying legacy of genocide—nearly two decades after their civil war ended. For the first time, survivors are finally able to properly bury thousands of relatives killed during the conflict, 17 years after the bloodshed ceased. Forensic experts are exhuming bodies from mass graves created by the Ixil Mayans during their flight into the mountains, where many died from starvation, hypothermia, disease, and direct military violence. Long ignored by state authorities, the Ixil gained international attention in May 2013 when a Guatemalan court convicted former dictator Efrain Rios Montt of genocide for his scorched-earth campaign against Mayan communities during his 17-month rule in the 1980s. That conviction was overturned just ten days later—offering little relief to the Ixil, whose lives remain unchanged. Nearly 20 years after the war, most Ixil still live in remote, rugged areas of northwestern Guatemala, in homes made of mud and wood, without clean water, paved roads, or access to basic health care and education. Byron Garcia, a social anthropologist who has worked in the region for a decade, says the Ixil remain trapped in the same poverty: 'People have been pushed to less fertile lands—stone-filled mountains where nothing grows. Those who can, farm small plots. When they can’t, they leave.' Feliciana Cobo was eight when soldiers attacked her village. She and her family fled into the mountains, hiding for days without food. Her mother was killed in the bombing; her grandmother died from exposure and illness. They lost their land—and their future. Now 40 and a single mother of three, Cobo borrows electricity from neighbors and survives by washing clothes and weaving textiles. 'I grew up during the war. I never went to school. All I know is how to weave.' She helped exhume her mother’s remains. 'I don’t know if it was smoke or the shock of the bombs—but we ran. When we regrouped, my mother was gone.' She doubts justice will ever be served, but finds solace that others traveled to testify at the trial. Anthropologist Edgar Hernandez shows children’s handwritten notes listing nearby villages—reminders of lives erased. For many Ixil, exhumations are not just forensic acts—they are sacred rites to prove their dead were real, not invented. Despite enduring hardship, the Ixil preserve their culture: women perform the traditional Sarabanda dance in Nebaj; elders pray before statues of Jesus dressed as Mayan ancestors in Cotzal; mothers cook tortillas over wood stoves in crumbling homes. As Garcia, now based in Guatemala City, puts it: 'They need to be heard. To be acknowledged. To find their loved ones—and give them a proper burial.'

Skatoties, kā antropologi rūpīgi atklāj laupīto tuvinieku pagaidu kapus, Ikšilu maiju tauta Gvatemalā saskaras ar ļoti briesmīgu ģenocīda mantojumu—gandrīz divdesmit gadus pēc pilsoņu kara beigām. Pirmo reizi pēc daudziem gadiem survi­vanti var piemīt kārtīgi apbedīt tūkstošiem tuvinieku, kas tika nogalināti konfliktā, 17 gadus pēc karā beigšanas. Forenzieki izraksta ķermeņus no masveida kapiem, ko Ikšilu maiji bija izveidojuši, bēgļu laikā kalnos, kur daudzi mira no badā, hipotermijas, slimībām un tiešas militārās vardarbības. Ilgu laiku ignorēti valsts iestāžu pusē, Ikšili saņēma starptautisku uzmanību 2013. gada maijā, kad Gvatemalas tiesa noliedza bijušo diktatoru Efraina Riosa Montu par ģenocīdu viņa 17 mēnešu valdīšanas laikā 1980. gados, kad tika lietotas dedzinātās zemes politikas pret maiju kopienām. Šis spriedums tika atcelts tikai desmit dienas vēlāk—nododot Ikšilu tautai nelielu atvieglojumu, jo to dzīves apstākļi palika neatmainīti. Gandrīz 20 gadus pēc kara lielākā daļa Ikšilu joprojām dzīvo attālās, kalnainās Gvatemalas ziemeļrietumu daļā, mājās no māla un koka, bez tīra ūdens, asfaltētām ceļiem vai pieejas pamata veselības aprūpei un izglītībai. Sociālais antropologs Birona Garčija, kas jau desmit gadus strādā šajā reģionā, saka, ka Ikšilu maiji joprojām ir iestājušies tajā pašā nabadzībā: 'Cilvēki ir izspiesti uz mazāk auglīgām zemēm—kalniem, kas sastāv no akmeņiem, kur nekas neaug. Tie, kas var, apsēj mazus laukus. Kad nevar, tie aiziet.' Feliciana Kobo bija astoņus gados, kad armija uzbruka viņas ciematam. Viņa un viņas ģimene aizbēga kalnos, slēpjoties dienas garumā bez ēdiena. Viņas māte tika nogalināta, bombardējot ciemu; tās vecmāmiņa mira vēlāk no aukstuma un slikto dzīves apstākļu. Viņi zaudēja savu zemi—un savu nākotni. Tagad 40 gadus veca un vienīga māte trīs bērniem, Kobo aizņem elektrību no kaimiņiem un izdzīvo, mazgājot kaimiņu drēbes un vītīdama audumus. 'Es izaugu kara laikā. Es nekad neesmu devusies skolā. Viss, ko es zinu, ir kā vītīt.' Viņa palīdzēja izrakt savas mātes atliekas. 'Es nezinu, vai tas bija dūmi vai bombu sprādzieni—bet mēs aizbēgam. Kad mēs atkal sapulcējāmies, mana māte jau bija mirusi.' Viņa šaubās, ka taisnība tiks nodota, bet atrod atvieglojumu, ka citi Ikšilu maiji varēja doties uz Gvatemalas pilsētu, lai stāstītu savas stāstus procesā. Antropologs Edgars Hernandess parāda bērnu rokrakstos uzrakstītos apkārtējo ciematu nosaukumus—atgādinājumus par izdzēstajām dzīvēm. Dažām Ikšilu maijiem ekskavācijas nav tikai forenzieku darbs—tās ir svētas rituālu formas, lai pierādītu, ka viņu mirušie bija reāli, nevis izdomāti. Neskatoties uz grūtībām, Ikšilu maiji saglabā savu kultūru: sievietes veic tradicionālo Sarabandas deju Nebajā; vecāki lūdzas pirms Jēzus Nāzarešāna statujām, apģērbtām kā Ikšilu maiju vecākiem, Kotzalā; mātes cep tortillas uz koka ugunīm sabrukstošās mājās. Kā Garčija, kas tagad dzīvo Gvatemalas galvaspilsētā, saka: 'Viņiem ir jādzird. Jāatzīst. Jāatrod viņu tuvinieki—un jādod tiem piemīts.'

article_content: The son of David West Sr., a flamboyant Soho nightclub owner nicknamed the 'King of the Booze Cruise,' has been charged with his murder after allegedly stabbing him during a drunken argument. David West Sr., 70, died from a single stab wound at his £2.5 million home in Mayfair on Friday. A divorced father of three, he had purchased the honorary title 'Lord of the Manor of Hollesley' on eBay and operated a £100 million business empire centered on budget wine and cigarette tours for British tourists. His son, also named David West, 44, lived with him in adjacent flats and was arrested nearby shortly after the incident. He is due to appear at Westminster Magistrates' Court. Friends described West Sr. as a charismatic figure known for his £5,000 Italian pink suits, mullet hairstyle, and crocodile-skin shoes — rising from a market stall in East London to become a celebrity of the UK's nightlife scene. He once sued David and Victoria Beckham for slander after they allegedly barred him from their 2006 World Cup party despite paying £100,000 for a ticket. He claimed they forbade him from carrying a mobile phone and deemed his suit inappropriate. The case was dismissed by a High Court judge. A year later, he hired Cherie Blair to challenge the UK’s public smoking ban — a signature policy of her husband Tony Blair’s government. Blair visited West’s erotic nightclub Hey Jo, named after his 21-year-old girlfriend Joanna Dudzik, whom he spent £400,000 on before taking her to court over excessive spending. The club’s explicit decor, including a 'bondage booth' and nurse-themed waitstaff, drew national attention. West Sr. also owned Abracadabra restaurant, Mandy’s gentlemen’s club, 4 Star Hostel, and a talent agency. Traces of polonium-210 were detected in Hey Jo in 2007 after two ex-KGB agents linked to the murder of Russian spy Alexander Litvinenko visited the venue. Born in Romford, Essex, West began as a market trader before co-founding greasy spoon cafes in Belgium and Calais. His company, EastEnders, became part of Europe’s largest British-owned cash-and-carry group, complete with its own wine brand, The Dogs B*******. His 30-year marriage ended in 1999 after he began a relationship with a 23-year-old French woman, followed by several younger partners. He admitted using Russian bride websites and once shared his flat with three Estonian women. His younger son, James, said the family wishes to keep the matter private. Business associate Harry Barnett, a friend for 60 years, expressed grief: 'They were very close. Dave lived with his dad all his life... It’s his other son, James, I feel for now. He’s lost his dad and his brother in one hit.' West once said of his children: 'I gave them some money — enough to start their own businesses — and waved them off. They drive flashy cars and wear designer gear, but I hope we raised them right. The best thing in the world would be to see them succeed in business. That’s all I ever wanted — and all I ever did.'

Gadu vēlāk viņš nodibināja advokāti Cherie Blair, lai cīnītos pret Apvienotās Karalistes sabiedriskās smēķēšanas aizliegumu — vienu no tās vīra Tony Blair valdības galvenajām politikām. Kluba eksplicītā dekorācija, ieskaitot 'saimniecības kabīni' un dienestmāsu tērpos apģērbtas servietes, izraisīja sensāciju. West Sr. arī piederēja Abracadabra restorānam, Mandy’s vīriešu klubam, 4 Star Hostel un talantu aģentūrai. 2007. gadā Hey Jo tika atklāts polonija-210, pēc tam, kad divi bijušie KGB agenti, kas tika aizdomājami par Krievijas cilvēka Aleksandra Litvinenko slepkavību, apmeklēja vietni. Dzimis Romfordā, Esksē, West sāka karjeru kā tirgus tirdzniecis, pirms kopā ar sievu Kathy atvēra grauzdētavas Beļģijā un Kalē. Viņa uzņēmums EastEnders kļuva par Eiropas lielāko britu īpašumā esošo kase un pārdošanas grupu ar savu vīna zīmolu, The Dogs B*******. Viņa 30 gadu laulība beidzās 1999. gadā, kad viņš sāka attiecības ar 23 gadu vecu franču blondi, pēc kuras sekoja vairāki jauni draugi. Viņš atzina, ka izmantoja Krievijas sieviešu laulības vietnes un vienreiz dalīja savu dzīvokli ar trim igauņu meitenēm. Viņa jaunākais dēls, Džeims, teica, ka ģimene vēlas saglabāt šo lietu privātu. Biznesa partneris Harijs Barnetts, draugs 60 gadus, izteica žēlību: 'Viņi bija ļoti tuvi. Deivs visu dzīvi dzīvoja ar savu tēvu... Man žēl tagad tikai Džeimsa. Viņš zaudējis gan tēvu, gan brāli.' West kādreiz sacīja par saviem bērniem: 'Es dodu viņiem daudz naudas — pietiekami, lai sāktu savus biznesus — un viņus uzsveicu. Viņi brauc ar spīdīgajām mašīnām un valkā mūsdienīgus dizainera apģērbus, bet es ceru, ka mēs viņus izaudzinājām pareizi. Vislabākais pasaulē būtu redzēt, kā viņi panāk veiksmi biznesā. Tas ir vispirms, ko es vienmēr vēlējos, un tas ir vispirms, ko es vienmēr darīju.'
